cases.case_name: Raysinh Atabhai Vala Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: BSNL ke kuch employees ne VRS liya. Unko mila hua compensation sarkar ne taxable maana. Appeal daali ki Section 10(10B) ke hisaab se yeh exempt hona chahiye.
cases.issue: Kya BSNL ka VRS compensation section 10(10B) ki exemption milegi ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, yeh compensation Section 10(10B) ke andar exempt hai. Department ko order diya ki dobara income calculate karo, aur refund banta ho toh wapas karo.
cases.takeaway: BSNL VRS lene wale employees ko section 10(10B) exemption claim karni chahiye. Agar refund banta hai toh department se follow up karein.

cases.case_name: Nascent Info Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Company ne PF aur ESI ka payment time pe nahi kiya, jisse expense disallow ho gaya. Income tax officer ne ₹4.43 lakh penalty laga di misreporting ke liye.
cases.issue: Kya sirf PF/ESI disallowance se misreporting proof ho jati hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola, sirf late deposit ki wajah se misreporting nahi mana ja sakta. Penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar PF/ESI ka payment late ho gaya hai aur penalty lag gayi ho, toh appeal mein challenge kiya ja sakta hai. Sirf disallowance pe penalty nahi lagti.

cases.case_name: Bank of Baroda & Anr. Vs Parasaadilal Tursiram Sheetgrah Pvt. Ltd. & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Ek SARFAESI auction mein bidder ne High Court mein stay le liya tha jabki 45 din ka time limit khatam ho chuka tha. Matter Supreme Court tak gaya.
cases.issue: Kya High Court SARFAESI auction ko 45 din baad bhi rok sakta hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne High Court ka stay order radd kar diya. Court ne bola ki 45 din ke baad challenge allowed nahi hai aur DRT ki power limited hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar SARFAESI auction mein challenge karna hai toh 45 din ke andar DRT mein file karein. High Court directly interfere nahi karegi agar time limit khatam ho gayi hai.

cases.case_name: Anand NVH Products Private Limited Vs National E Assessment Centre Delhi & Anr. (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Company ka assessment pending tha aur taxpayer DRP (Dispute Resolution Panel) ke saamne gaya tha. Department ne DRP ka decision aaye bina final assessment order, demand notice aur penalty bhej diya.
cases.issue: Kya DRP ka decision aaye bina assessment order pass kar sakte hain?
cases.held: High Court ne assessment order, demand aur penalty notice sabko radd kar diya kyunki DRP ka decision nahi aaya tha. Proper process follow karna zaroori hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar DRP mein matter pending hai, department assessment order nahi nikal sakta. Aise case mein High Court jaa sakte hain.

cases.case_name: S. S. Iron & Steel & Anr. Vs Union of India and Ors. (Calcutta High Court)
cases.facts: GST department ne kai saal ke liye consolidated show cause notice diya. Party ne direct High Court mein challenge kiya. Department ne bola ki pehle appeal karo.
cases.issue: Kya consolidated GST show cause notice direct High Court mein challenge ki ja sakti hai?
cases.held: High Court ne bola ki abhi statutory appeal u/s 107 available hai, toh High Court direct zahmat nahi karega. Limitation ka objection bhi nahi utha sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST ka consolidated notice mila hai toh pehle Section 107 ke andar appeal file karo, High Court direct nahi jaa sakte.

cases.case_name: Phoenix ARC Private Limited Vs Cherupushpam Films Private Limited (NCLT Kochi)
cases.facts: Phoenix ARC ne loan recover karne section 7 application daali. Lekin unka debt assignment deed theek se stamped nahi tha aur trustee ki authority prove nahi ho paayi.
cases.issue: Kya bina proper stamp duty aur trustee proof ke section 7 IBC case admit ho sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLT ne case dismiss kar diya kyunki deed par sahi stamp nahi thi, aur trustee ki authority clear nahi thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar bank ya ARC insolvency ke liye court jana chahe to pehle debt assignment deed par proper stamp duty de aur trustee ki authority ki document ready rakhe.

cases.case_name: Dickey Special Situation Investment Trust-DSSF Series 2 Vs Manish Agarwal (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Worlds Window Exim ka resolution plan defect tha, default ka reason sahi se address nahi kiya. NCLAT ne plan reject kiya, liquidation order diya aur investigation bhi. Assignee ki recovery par pehle se laga cap hata diya.
cases.issue: Kya defective resolution plan ko accept kiya jaa sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne resolution plan reject kar diya, liquidation aur investigation ka order diya. Assignee ki recovery par jo cap laga tha, wo hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Resolution plan banate waqt default ka asal reason jarur dikhayein. Varna plan reject ho sakta hai aur company liquidation mein ja sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Pinarayi Vijayan Vs K M Shajahan & Ors. (Supreme Court)
cases.facts: Supreme Court ne ek High Court ke FIR direction ke khilaaf appeal lagane ka haq diya. Investigation 10 din ke liye rok di. ECIR ki validiity ka mudda abhi decide nahi hua.
cases.issue: Kya High Court ke FIR direction ke khilaaf Supreme Court me appeal ho sakti hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne appeal wapas bahal ki aur 10 din ke liye investigation roki. Case ki merits abhi decide nahi hui.
cases.takeaway: Agar FIR direction se problem hai to Supreme Court se interim protection mil sakti hai. Par court merits alag se dekhegi.

cases.case_name: VCO Consultants and Services Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: VCO Consultants ke case mein 1302 din tak delay ho gaya PF/ESI disallowance ki appeal file karne mein. Issue ₹43.48 lakh ka tha. Section 143(1) ki challenge bhi pending thi.
cases.issue: Itne lambi delay mein appeal allow karni chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne delay condone kiya aur matter dobara dekhne ko wapas bhej diya. Saath hi Section 143(1) wali baat bhi fresh examine hogi.
cases.takeaway: Agar appeal late ho jaye to genuine reason ho to delay condone ho sakti hai. PF/ESI disallowance pe fresh hearing mil sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Shreeji Developers & Anr. Vs State of Gujarat & Ors. (Gujarat High Court)
cases.facts: Shreeji Developers ke khilaf duplicate GSTR-1 entries ki wajah se GST demand thi. Hearing ka mauka nahi mila tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina sunwai diye GST demand lagana sahi hai?
cases.held: High Court ne GST demand radd kar di. Personal hearing ke saath dobara case sunne ka order diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar notice milti hai to personal hearing jarur maangein. Duplicate entries par bina sunwai ke demand nahi ho sakti.

cases.case_name: H.M. Traders Vs Goods and Services Tax Officer (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: H.M. Traders ka GST SCN portal ke additional notices tab mein upload hua, jo unko dikha nahi. Is wajah se order pass ho gaya.
cases.issue: Kya galat jagah notice upload karne se order valid rahega?
cases.held: Court ne order hata diya aur fresh hearing ka mauka diya. Notification ki validity baad mein decide hogi.
cases.takeaway: SCN portal par check karo ki notice kahaan upload hui hai. Galat tab mein ho to turant objection bhejo.

cases.case_name: Warmmax India Vs Commissioner of the SGST and Another (Jharkhand High Court)
cases.facts: Warmmax India par GST Section 73 mein 27 April 2024 ko order aaya bina personal hearing ke. Company ne iske khilaf court mein case kiya.
cases.issue: Kya bina personal hearing ke GST ka order sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne GST order radd kar diya. Judge ne fresh hearing ke baad dobara adjudicate karne ko kaha.
cases.takeaway: Section 73 ka notice aaye to personal hearing ki demand likhit mein jarur karein. Dobara notice milne par sab document ready rakhein.

cases.case_name: Satish Vohra and Others Vs State of Punjab and Another (Punjab and Haryana High Court)
cases.facts: Income tax prosecution pehli se settlement ho gaya tha aur Benami Act ki findings final thi. Court ne aage prosecution chalana bekaar samjha.
cases.issue: Kya settlement ke baad income tax prosecution chal sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne saaf kaha ki prosecution ka koi fayda nahi, isliye case khatam kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar settlement proceedings puri ho jayen aur Benami case ka final order aa jaye to prosecution radd ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: VCO Consultants and Services Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Yahan ek company thi jo service business karti thi. Department ne PF aur ESI ki payment late hone par Rs. 43.48 lakh ka disallowance kara aur Section 143(1) ke through issue uthaya. Appeal mein company ne 1,302 din der se file ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya itni zyada delay condone ki ja sakti hai aur disallowance wapas se check ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne company ka delay maaf kar diya. Saari baat wapas Assessing Officer ko fresh check ke liye bhej di, saath hi Section 143(1) ka challenge bhi include kara.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka appeal kaafi der se bhi file hua ho, lekin reason genuine hai, to delay condone ho sakta hai. PF/ESI disallowance par fresh hearing mil sakti hai, saare facts dubara rakhna zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Shreeji Developers & Anr. Vs State of Gujarat & Ors. (Gujarat High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan developer ka case tha jisme GSTR-1 form mein entry galti se do baar ho gayi. Department ne iski basis par GST demand nikal di bina proper sunwai ke.
cases.issue: Kya bina sunwai diye GST demand nikalna sahi hai agar duplicate entry ho?
cases.held: High Court ne department ka demand order radd kar diya. Matter fresh sunwai aur personal hearing ke liye wapas bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke GST records mein mistake ho jaaye, to apni baat rakhne ka mauka milna chahiye. Bina sunwai ke final demand nahi ban sakta.

cases.case_name: Satish Vohra and Others Vs State of Punjab and Another (Punjab and Haryana High Court)
cases.facts: Is case mein taxpayer par income tax ki prosecution chal rahi thi. Baad mein settlement proceed hua aur Benami Act ke tehat property ka final faisla bhi ho gaya tha.
cases.issue: Final settlement aur Benami Act finding ke baad prosecution continue ho sakti hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne prosecution radd kar di. Bola ki settlement ho chuka hai to fir criminal case chala kar fayda nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar settlement ya Benami ka order ho jaaye, to criminal prosecution bhi khatam ho sakta hai. Dono side ka faisla ek saath nahi chal sakta.

cases.case_name: H.M. Traders Vs Goods and Services Tax Officer (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek trader ka GST case tha. Department ne show cause notice (SCN) Additional Notices tab mein daal diya, isliye party ko pata hi nahi chala. Baad mein department ne order pass kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya bina proper notice diye order pass karna sahi hai GST mein?
cases.held: Court ne GST order ko radd kar diya. Bola ki party ko mauka dena zaruri hai aur poora notice sahi jagah upload karna chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Hamesha verify karo ki koi notice portal par kahan upload hua. Agar SCN galat tab mein hai aur party ko nahi pata, to order invalidate ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Indian Roadways Corporation Ltd. Vs PCIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Is case mein IT Department ne ek company ke khilaaf completed assessment mein Section 263 revision start kar diya. Search mein koi naya document ya incriminating material nahi mila tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf suspicion pe Section 263 revision ho sakta hai jab koi nayi evidence nahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 263 revision quash kar di. Bola ki bina incriminating material ke completed assessment ko dubara nahi khola ja sakta.
cases.takeaway: Aapke case mein agar search hui ho par kuch bhi naya document nahi mile, to completed assessment ko revision se bachaya ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Warmmax India Vs Commissioner of the SGST and Another (Jharkhand High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek GST registered company ka case tha. Department ne Section 73 ke under tax demand banaya par bina personal hearing diye order pass ho gaya.
cases.issue: Kya bina personal hearing diye Section 73 order valid hai?
cases.held: High Court ne order cancel kar diya. Bola ki bina sunwai diye order banana galat hai – ab company ko neya chance milega apni baat rakhne ka.
cases.takeaway: Jab bhi aapko Section 73 ka notice mile, hearing ka mauka zarur mangna chahiye. Personal hearing na mile to order radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Samarth Nagari Shakari Path Sanstha Maryadit Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Ek co-operative society ka case tha. Society ne apne profit par Section 80P ka deduction claim kiya tha. Department ne is par objection uthaya.
cases.issue: Society ko Section 80P ka deduction milna chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne society ko ₹33.23 lakh ka deduction allow kiya. Court ne Supreme Court ke Mavilayi aur Rena Sahakari decisions ka sahara liya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap co-operative society hain, to Section 80P deduction claim karne ke liye Supreme Court ke mawjud decisions ka hindi me reference ready rakhiye.

cases.case_name: Dakshinamoorthy Kumaresan Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ek aadmi par penalty lagayi gayi thi. Notice mein likha tha ki galat particulars diye hain, lekin order mein concealment bola tha.
cases.issue: Jab notice aur order alag charges dikhayein to penalty lagi reh sakti hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty radd kar di. Reason yeh tha ki notice aur penalty order mein alag alag kaaran diye gaye the.
cases.takeaway: Agar notice aur penalty order mein alag alag offence likha hai, to aap penalty challenge kar sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Saroj Kumar Haldar Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: BSNL ke kuch retirees ne VRS compensation par exemption claim kiya tha. Assessing Officer ne in appeals ko mana kar diya tha.
cases.issue: VRS-2019 compensation par Section 10(10B) exemption milni chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne exemption allow kar di. Yeh decision pehle ITAT ke similar cases ko dekh kar diya gaya.
cases.takeaway: Aap BSNL ya kisi PSU VRS-2019 retiree hain, to Section 10(10B) exemption ka claim confidently daal sakte hain, lekin saare documents ready rakhein.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Rakesh Kumar Malani (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Ek assessee ne short-term capital gains par Section 87A ka rebate claim kiya. Department ne mana kar diya kyunki yeh STCG Section 111A ke under aata tha.
cases.issue: Section 111A STCG par 87A rebate milti hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne decision diya ki Section 87A rebate STCG par bhi mil sakti hai agar AY 2025-26 hai. Revenue ki appeal kharij ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke short-term capital gains Section 111A ke under hain to bhi Section 87A rebate mil sakti hai, khas taur par AY 2025-26 ke liye.

cases.case_name: Vikas Ashokkumar Masand Vs DCIT (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Ek petrol pump owner ne demonetisation ke time cash collect kiya tha. Department ne Section 69A mein addition kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Demonetisation period ka cash, agar proper business records hain, to Section 69A mein add ho sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Unhone dekha ki cash receipts business ke ledgers aur debtor records se match ho rahi thi.
cases.takeaway: Demonetisation ke samay ka cash deposit justify karna hai to debtor ledger aur business record ready rakho; sahi proof ho to addition delete ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Saiyed Zaharul Alam Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Assessee ne apne expenses ke against koi khas defect show nahi hone diya. Department ne 20% expenses ad hoc disallow kar diye.
cases.issue: Kya bina koi specific defect paye ad hoc expenses disallow kiye ja sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne ad hoc disallowance hata diya. Unhone kaha ki jab tak koi particular kharabi records mein nahi milti, aise hi disallow karna sahi nahi.
cases.takeaway: Expense disallowance se bachne ke liye, department ko koi ek specific defect point out karne do; warna ad hoc disallowance defend ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Khushi Advertising Ideas Private Limited (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Ye company ka case tha. Tax dept ne ₹1.5 crore ka kharcha WhatsApp chats aur third-party statements ke basis par jod diya. Lekin court ne dekha koi solid proof nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf WhatsApp chats aur dusre aadmi ke bayan par itna bada kharcha jodna sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola, bina pakke saboot ke aisa addition nahi ho sakta. WhatsApp reference aur third-party statement kaafi nahi hai jab tak independent proof na ho.
cases.takeaway: Agar dept sirf unverified WhatsApp chats ya dusre bande ki baat par paisa jod raha hai to uska oppose karo. Corroborating evidence maango.

cases.case_name: Sweta Somani Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Ye ek lady ka case tha jisme property ka value kitna hai is par dispute tha. Dept ne ₹27.42 lakh jod diye kyunki property sasti dikhaayi thi. Court ne dekha ki cheque se payment hua tha ya nahi, iski bhi clarity nahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya property ki value ka addition bina proper DVO ke review ke sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola, property valuation ka mamla DVO (Valuer) dobara dekhe. Cheque payment ka proof bhi check ho. Phir decide ho.
cases.takeaway: Agar property valuation mein doubt hai, to DVO ka fresh report mangwa lo. Agreement ke waqt payment ka evidence ready rakho.

cases.case_name: Karan Dilipkumar Patel Vs DCIT (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Ye capital gains ka case tha, jisme ₹4.93 crore ka dispute tha kyunki land agriculture thi ya nahi decide nahi ho paya. Dept ne poocha ki land municipal limit se kitni door hai aur valuation sahi hai ya nahi.
cases.issue: Kya agricultural land ka distance aur value sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki land ki distance aur valuation pehle verify ho. Tabhi capital gains ka decision ho.
cases.takeaway: Agricultural land bech rahe ho, to municipal limit ki proper map aur land ki valuation ki proof ready rakho.

cases.case_name: Abhishek Sharan Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Ye case builder entry par tha. Dept ne ₹24 lakh ka addition kar diya kyunki builder ke computer mein cash entry thi. Par us entry ka koi pakka proof nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf builder ke computer entry se cash payment maan sakte hain?
cases.held: Court ne bola, bina dusre solid proof ke aisi entry par paisa jodna galat hai. Sirf uncorroborated entry par nahi chal sakte.
cases.takeaway: Builder ki registry entry ya computer record ke basis par agar addition ho raha hai to pakka external evidence maango.

cases.case_name: Accord Distillers & Brewers Private Limited Vs PCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Ye ek company ka case tha. Dept ne assessment ko Section 263 se revise kiya tha par usi assessment year ki settlement commission se final order aa chuki thi.
cases.issue: Kya settlement commission ka order ke baad Section 263 revision chal sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne kaha, jab assessment settlement commission se final ho gaya ho to Section 263 se revise nahi kar sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar settlement commission ka order mil gaya ho to ussi year mein dept. 263 revision ki notice kare to uspar turant point uthao.

cases.case_name: Shruti Amar Mehta Vs ACIT (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Ye case unexplained investment ka tha. Dept ne ₹30 lakh jod diye kyunki kisi aur buyer ke naam se cash ki entry mili thi. Lekin court ne dekha koi konkret proof nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf third-party ki seized entry ke basis par assessee pe addition sahi hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola, agar cash entry kisi aur buyer ke naam milti hai aur concrete saboot nahi hai to assessee par addition galat hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke against third-party entry par addition ho raha hai to pucca proof maang sakte ho, bina corroboration ke addition nahi hona chahiye.

cases.case_name: Sahkari Ganna Vikas Samiti Limited Vs ACIT Sitapur/CPC (ITAT Lucknow)
cases.facts: Ek co-op society ka case tha. Inhone apni ITR late bhari thi. CPC ne is wajah se Section 80P ki ₹1.64 crore deduction disallow kar di.
cases.issue: Kya CPC late ITR file hone par Section 80P ki deduction mana kar sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT Lucknow ne kaaha ki CPC ke paas yeh power nahi hai ki woh late ITR ke chakkar mein Section 80P deduction rok de. Isliye society ko puri deduction milni chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap co-op society hain aur late ITR file hui ho, fir bhi Section 80P deduction mil sakti hai. Disallowance sirf department notice se ho, CPC apne aap nahi kar sakta.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Hitesh S. Mehta (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Yahaan Revenue ne unexplained share investment aur bank deposit pe addition kari thi. Assessee ne ₹2.77 crore interest expense claim kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya unexplained investment add ho sakti hai aur kya interest expense allow hoga?
cases.held: ITAT ne sari unexplained investment aur deposit wali addition hata di. ₹2.77 crore ka interest expense bhi allow kar diya. Revenue ki appeal fail ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap ke investment transactions genuine hain aur records dikh gaye, toh addition hata di jayegi. Interest claim bhi sahi ho toh mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Yanfeng India Automotive Interior Systems Pvt. Ltd. Vs Joint CIT (OSD) (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Company ne apne associated enterprise (AE) ko ₹3.07 crore reimburse kiye. Department ne bola koi actual service ya business proof nahi diya gaya, toh ALP zero lagayi.
cases.issue: Kya reimbursement pe ALP zero ho sakta hai jab tak koi business link ka proof na ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaaha, kyunki assessee ne service aur business connection ka koi saboot nahi diya, isliye ₹3.07 crore ka ALP zero theek hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar AE ko payment kar rahe ho toh har service ka kaam aur proof zaroor file karo, nahi toh pura ALP zero ho jayega.

cases.case_name: Adama India Pvt. Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Assessee ne AE ko management services ke ₹5.10 crore diye. Department ne ALP zero laga diya aur ya SBI lending rate laga kar adjustment kara tha.
cases.issue: Kya AE se management services liye paison pe ALP zero ya SBI lending rate se adjustment sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT Hyderabad ne bola department ALP zero nahi kar sakta bina basis ke. SBI lending rate se bhi adjustment galat hai. Sari TP adjustment hata di.
cases.takeaway: AE ki services ka sahi benchmarking aur documents zaruri hain. Department bina logic zero nahi kar sakta.

cases.case_name: Henkel Chembond Surface Technologies Ltd. Vs ACIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Yahaan regional management services pe ₹3.73 crore ka TP adjustment hua. Department ne ALP ko bina method ka use kiye direct zero kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya TPO ALP ko bina koi prescribed method ke use kiye zero kar sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne ₹3.73 crore ka adjustment hata diya. Bola bina method ke direct ALP zero lagana galat hai.
cases.takeaway: Transfer pricing mein, department ko prescribed method use karna padega. Sirf andaz se ALP zero nahi kar sakte.

cases.case_name: Balakrishna Venkapppa Bhandary Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Assessee ne property purchase ki. Department ne allotment date pe stamp duty value check kari aur ₹26.98 lakh ka addition Section 56(2)(x) mein kiya.
cases.issue: Kya stamp duty allotment-date pe 10% se andar ho toh Section 56(2)(x) addition banti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di kyunki allotment date stamp value market value se 10% ke andar thi.
cases.takeaway: Property lene dene mein allotment date ki stamp value aur 10% ka margin check karo, extra addition nahi hogi.

cases.case_name: Raashi Constructions Vs Assistant Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (Karnataka High Court)
cases.facts: Raashi Constructions ka case tha. GST department ne inke khilaaf notice bheja, par email notice ko lekar confusion ho gaya. Company ko apna jawab dene ka mauka theek se nahi mila.
cases.issue: Kya bina sahi sunwai ke GST demand lagana theek hai?
cases.held: Court ne GST demand aur garnishee notice dono ko radd kar diya. Bola ki ab fresh se reply dene ka mauka diya jaaye aur sirf 10% tax pehle deposit karwana hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar notice email ya kisi aur tarike se sahi nahi mila hai, toh department se likhit mein clarification mang lo. Sunwai ka pura right hai, bina sunaaye order aaye toh court se relief mil sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Shobha Sudamrao Tagad Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Shobha Sudamrao Tagad ka business tha. AO ne 1.66 crore ka Adat commission bogus bata kar disallow kar diya. Lekin payment banking channel se hui thi aur TDS bhi kata tha.
cases.issue: Kya AO bina solid proof ke commission ko bogus maan sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne disallowance hata di, bola ki books audit hui hain, payees pehchane jaa sakte hain, sab kuch banking channel se hua aur TDS bhi kata gaya hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar sab payment banking se aur TDS proper katega toh commission ke disallow hone ka risk bahut kam hai. Commission payee ka proof aur transaction details saaf honi chahiye.

cases.case_name: Sidique Ibrahim Allana Vs ACIT (International Taxation) (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Ek NRI ke khilaaf ₹5.5 crore investment Section 69 ke andar add kiya gaya. Sirf ek WhatsApp message '550' milne ki wajah se. Koi actual document ya paisa ka record nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya WhatsApp par sirf number aane se investment maan liya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition radd kardi. Bola WhatsApp ka sirf ek number bina koi corroboration ke investment prove nahi karta.
cases.takeaway: Sirf WhatsApp chat messages tax assessment mein valid proof nahi hai. Investment prove karne ke liye bank entry ya actual transfer ka evidence zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Sumitra Rajeshbhai Jain (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Penny stock ke case mein reassessment notice 29 July 2022 ko diya gaya tha. TOLA (covid extension) ke baad limitation period khatam ho chuka tha.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment notice jab limitation ke baad issue ho, toh woh valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment pura radd kar diya. Bola ki TOLA ke baad limitation period khatam ho gaya, isliye notice invalid hai.
cases.takeaway: Assessment/reassessment ka notice TOLA period ke andar hi aana chahiye. Covid extensions check karna mat bhoolo—late notice ko court radd kar sakta hai.

cases.facts: Ek family company dispute mein NCLAT ke paas appeal aayi. Lower court ne pehle Supreme Court ke order ka palan karte hue order diya tha. Koi naya mudda nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya Supreme Court ka pehle ka order sirf replicate karke appeal par decide kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne appeal dismiss kar di. Bola ki lower court ne Supreme Court ke directive ko follow kiya to naya kuch decide nahi karna tha.
cases.takeaway: Family ya company disputes mein agar Supreme Court ne pehle hi order pass kiya hai, toh simply compliance follow hota hai. Nayi appeal ka jyada scope nahi rehta.

cases.case_name: Kaizen Motoventures Private Limited Vs ACIT (ITAT Raipur)
cases.section: Section 148A(b) - Reopening ke notice mein 7 din ka mauka dena hota hai
cases.facts: Kaizen Motoventures Private Limited ka case tha. Department ne unko Section 148A(b) ka notice diya, par reply dene ke liye sirf 6 clear din diye.
cases.issue: Kya 6 din ka notice dena sahi hai jab kanoon 7 din bolta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola minimum 7 clear din milne chahiye reply ke liye. 6 din diye, isliye reassessment ki poori karwai radd kar di.
cases.takeaway: Agar Section 148A(b) ka notice aaye, to reply ke liye kam se kam 7 clear din milne chahiye. Kam din diye to appeal pakka banega.

cases.case_name: Chowaram Dhiwar Vs ITO (TAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Chowaram Dhiwar ka assessment khola gaya. Notice issue kiya ek aise officer ne jiske paas is case ka area/jurisdiction nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina jurisdiction wale officer ka notice valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki bina jurisdiction officer ka notice illegal hai. Pure reassessment ko radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Hamesha dekho ki aapko notice jis officer ne diya, uske paas aapka case dekhne ka adhikar hai ya nahi.

cases.case_name: AVO Carbon India Private Limited Vs Assessing Officer (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: AVO Carbon India Pvt Ltd par ₹7.25 crore transfer pricing adjustment laga diya gaya tha management service fees par. Pehle bhi isi tarah ka case unke khilaaf decide hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya management service fees ka ALP Nil maana ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki consistency ke liye management fees ka ALP zero nahi ho sakta. Purane decisions bhi consider kiye. Adjustment hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar management fees par adjustment ho, to pehle ke apne decided cases jarur lagao. Proper documentation rakho ki service li hai.

cases.case_name: Ajay Singh Vs DCIT (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.section: Section 153C - Dusre ke case se document milne par assessment
cases.facts: Ajay Singh ka case dusre case se milay documents ki wajah se khola gaya tha. Section 153C lagaya tha. Jurisdiction proper tarike se nahi dikhaya gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya jurisdiction ki kami Section 153B ki deadline se thik ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki agar jurisdiction ki kami hai to assessment radd hoga. Sirf completion ki deadline puri karne se kuch nahi hota.
cases.takeaway: Dekh lo ki 153C me assessment shuru karne se pehle AO ne puri process follow ki ya nahi, khas kar documents aur jurisdiction.

cases.case_name: Dilip N. Thakkar HUF Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.section: Section 271(1)(c) - Galat income disclose par penalty
cases.facts: Dilip N. Thakkar HUF par bogus purchase ki wajah se ₹2.26 lakh ki penalty lagi thi. Addition sirf 3% estimate par hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya estimate basis par ki gayi addition par penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki sirf 3% estimate ki addition par penalty nahi lag sakti. Penalty delete kar di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Jab addition sirf estimate basis par ho, to us par penalty ke khilaf appeal pakka banega.

cases.case_name: Vijay Baburao Patil Gurav Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.section: Section 69A - Income jo books me nahi milti
cases.facts: Vijay Baburao Patil Gurav par ₹2.24 lakh ka addition hua tha, kehte hue ki plot payment extra hui. Par iske koi document ya statement nahi diye.
cases.issue: Kya bina document ke Section 69A ka addition sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki jab tak koi proof nahi hai, addition nahi ho sakta. Addition delete kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Section 69A me addition karte waqt department ko proper document dena hoga. Sirf shak par addition nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Dhanshri Multi State Co-operative Credit Society Ltd. (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Society ka business tha credit facility chalana. Unhone ₹4.35 crore ka interest income dikhaya. Department ne bola ki Section 80P(4) ki wajah se deduction nahi milega kyunki banking license nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina RBI banking license ke society ko 80P deduction mil sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki 80P(4) sirf un societies par lagu hai jinke paas actual banking license ho. Normal cooperative credit society ko deduction milni chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapki cooperative credit society ke paas RBI banking license nahi hai, to aap interest income par 80P deduction confidently claim kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Chelco Bind Grips Vs Commissioner of CGST & CE (GSTAT Thiruvananthapuram)
cases.facts: GST authority ne Chelco Bind Grips ko Section 74 ke tahat ITC ka demand aur penalty lagayi thi. Appellate Authority ne bola ki yahan fraud nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina fraud ke Section 74 lag sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne demand aur penalty ko hata diya, kyunki fraud sabit nahi hua tha. Sirf tax demand rakha aur penalty Section 73 mein shift hui.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par bina fraud ke Section 74 ki penalty lagi ho, to aap appeal mein us penalty ko khatam karwa sakte ho. Sirf tax liability bachegi.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Dignesh Pramukhlal Patel (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: ACIT ne reassessment notice diya, jabki pehle woh point check ho chuka tha. Gujarat HC ne notice ko khatam kar diya tha. Revenue ne Supreme Court me appeal ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya purane opinion ko badal kar reassessment notice diya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Revenue ki appeal ko radd kar diya, bola change of opinion se notice invalid hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke khilaaf Section 148 notice sirf opinion change hone par aaya ho, to usko court me challenge kiya ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Jovin George Vs Assistant Commissioner (Kerala High Court)
cases.facts: GST department ne composite show cause notice diya jo 2020-21 se 2023-24 tak ke 4 saal cover karta tha. Taxpayer ne challenge kiya ki yeh notice valid nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya ek saath kai saalon ka composite GST notice legal hai?
cases.held: High Court ne notice radd kar diya. Bola, har saal ka alag notice hona chahiye. Limitation ka bhi dhyan rakhna hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko ek hi GST notice mein kai saal cover kar diye ho, to court mein usko illegal challange kiya ja sakta hai. Har year ka notice alag hona zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: ELCA Cosmetics Pvt. Ltd Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: ELCA Cosmetics par ₹5.02 crore ka royalty adjustment kiya gaya tha un franchise agreements ke basis par jo execute hi nahi huye. Company ne aur bhi kharche claim kiye, jaise RSU aur IT expenses.
cases.issue: Kya unexecuted agreements ke basis par royalty adjustment ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki bina sign huye agreement ko basis bana kar royalty adjustment nahi ho sakta. RSU, IT aur promotion expenses bhi allow kiye. Loss set-off verify karwane ki direction di.
cases.takeaway: Aapke upar addition sirf un documents par ho sakti hai jo actual mein execute hue hain. Draft agreements par nahi.

cases.case_name: Manish Kumar Kotawala Vs DCIT (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Department ne reassessment notice March 2024 mein diya tha, jab purana 6 saal ka limit khatam ho chuka tha. Ye notice AY 2015-16 ke liye tha.
cases.issue: Kya March 2024 mein AY 2015-16 ka reassessment possible tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne notice radd kar diya, kyunki 6 saal ka time limit cross ho chuka tha as per Section 149.
cases.takeaway: Agar department purana time-limit cross hone ke baad notice bheje, to aap usko time-barred bol kar court mein radd karwa sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Nurani Subramanian Suryanarayanan Vs Employees State Insurance Corporation & Ors. (NCLAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Liquidation ke dauraan company ke ESI contributions ko lekar jhagda tha. Liquidator ne unhe liquidation estate mein include kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya ESI trust money liquidation estate ka hissa banti hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne bola ki jo ESI fund trust mein hai, woh liquidation estate ka part nahi ban sakta. Ye paisa directly ESI Corporation ko milega.
cases.takeaway: Company liquidation ke case mein ESI contribution wali amount ko trust paisa maana jayega aur woh employees ke liye secured rahega.

cases.case_name: Commissioner of Commercial Tax & Ors. Vs Vikaram Cement (Supreme Court)
cases.facts: Department ne 25.47 lakh ki tax recovery ke liye Supreme Court mein appeal file ki thi. CBIC ka naya rule aaya tha ki 2 crore se kam ke cases Supreme Court mein appeal nahi kiye jayenge. Lekin purane appeals abhi pending the.
cases.issue: Kya CBIC ka ₹2 crore appeal limit rule purane, pending appeals par bhi lagega?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne saaf bola ki jo 2 crore se kam ke appeals hai, unko dismiss kiya jayega. Matlab purane pending appeals par bhi yeh limit lagu hai. Legal point ko open chhoda hai, final ruling nahi di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka GST dispute 2 crore se kam ka hai to Supreme Court tak nahi ja sakenge - CBIC ka monetary limit purane aur naye dono appeals par lagega.

cases.case_name: Alpha National Trading Co. Vs ACIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Yeh case ek trading company ka tha. ACIT ne bina valid Section 143(2) notice diye assessment kiya. Section 143(2) notice assessment karne se pehle dena zaroori hota hai.
cases.issue: Kya assessment valid hai agar Section 143(2) notice nahi diya gaya?
cases.held: ITAT ne Calcutta High Court ke purane faisele follow kiye. Bola assessment bina Section 143(2) notice diye hua hai to void hai, isliye assessment radd kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko Section 143(2) notice timely nahi mila hai to assessment khatam ho sakta hai. Hamesha notice ki copy sambhal ke rakhein.

cases.case_name: Shri Avadh Nagarik Sahkari Mandli Ltd. Vs PCIT-1 (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.section: Section 263 (Revision by CIT), Section 80P (Deduction for co-op societies)
cases.facts: Ek co-operative society ka case tha jise AO ne Section 80P ki deduction inquiry ke baad allow kar di. PCIT ne baad mein Section 263 laga diya ki AO ne galat kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 263 revision ho sakta hai jab AO ne inquiry karke deduction di ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola AO ne inquiry ki aur lawful deduction diya, isliye PCIT Section 263 laga ke revise nahi kar sakta. Revision cancel kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Section 263 sirf tab lagega jab AO bina inquiry kuch allow kar de. Proper inquiry hui to revision nahi ho sakta.

cases.case_name: Felicity Adobe LLP Vs ACIT (Karnataka High Court)
cases.facts: Felicity Adobe LLP ka GST ITC (Input Tax Credit) mismatch batakar order pass kiya gaya. Authority ne GSTR-2A aur GSTR-3B ki reconciliation sahi se check nahi ki.
cases.issue: Kya reconciliation ignore karke ITC order pass ho sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki reconciliation ignore karna galat hai. Order wapas bhej diya ki firm ko fair hearing do aur sahi reconciliation check karo.
cases.takeaway: Aapke ITC mismatch ke cases mein sahi reconciliation evidence submit karo. Agar authority ignore kare to order quash ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Vintage Distillers Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Vintage Distillers ki 6 saal ki assessments radd ho gayi. Reason tha Section 148 notice mein galti, Section 149 ki time limit cross ho gayi thi, aur Section 148B ka procedure follow nahi hua.
cases.issue: Kya assessment valid hai jab notice aur procedure mein defect ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne saaf bola assessment notices defective hain aur time-barred hain, isliye six assessments cancel kiya.
cases.takeaway: Reopening notices mein koi technical ya timing ki galti ho to pura assessment khatm ho sakta hai. Notice ke points check karna zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Equipment Finance Limited Vs Kitply Industries Limited (NCLT Guwahati)
cases.facts: SREI group ne Kitply par ₹333.59 crore ka loan outstanding batakar Insolvency case file kiya. Kitply ne bola ki loan ki terms hi disputed hain. Section 65 ki penalty bhi maangi gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya disputed loan pe Section 7 mein insolvency admit ho sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLT ne petition radd kar di. Bola, dispute hai toh insolvency process nahi chalega. Section 65 penalty bhi nahi lagi.
cases.takeaway: Agar loan par clear dispute hai to direct insolvency proceedings nahi ho sakte. Proper documentation aur dispute ka record maintain karo.

cases.case_name: Sharda Jain Vs PCIT-1 (Chhattisgarh High Court)
cases.facts: Madam Sharda Jain ke case mein department ne assessment year 2015-16 ke liye 1 April 2021 ke baad naya reassessment notice bheja. Supreme Court ke TOLA limitation ke rules ke baad bhi aisa kiya.
cases.issue: Kya 1 April 2021 ke baad reassessment ka notice valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki ye notice illegal hai. Supreme Court ke order ke baad department aise notice nahi bhej sakta tha. Section 148A(d) orders aur Section 148 notices radd kar diye.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko 1 April 2021 ke baad ka assessment notice mila hai to Supreme Court ki TOLA limitation check karo. Ho sakta hai notice invalid ho.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs NSL Nagapatnam Power Ventures Private Limited (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: NSL Nagapatnam Power ne 2017-18 mein koi exempt income nahi dikhayi thi. Department ne phir bhi Rs. 3.60 crore Section 14A ke under disallow kar diya.
cases.issue: Jab exempt income hi nahi hai to Section 14A ka disallowance ho sakta hai kya?
cases.held: ITAT ne clear bola ki jab exempt income nahi hai to Section 14A disallowance nahi lag sakta. Jo 2022 mein law badla hai uska purane years par effect nahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar exempt income nahi hai to Section 14A ka disallowance nahin lagega, Finance Act 2022 ka amendment sirf future par lagega.

cases.case_name: Aditya Plastic Vs ITO (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Aditya Plastic ke reassessment approval par officer ka sign nahi tha, na hi usme DIN (Document Identification Number) tha. Department ne assessment khola aur penalty bhi laga di.
cases.issue: Kya bina sahi approval ke reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki bina proper sign aur DIN ke approval valid nahi. Isliye reassessment aur penalty dono radd kar diye.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment approval mein officer ka sign aur DIN hona zaroori hai. Nahi hai to pura case gir sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Biophore India Pharmaceuticals Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Biophore India Pharmaceuticals ko department ne Section 263 lagaya aur Rs. 32.50 lakh ka Section 14A disallowance bola jabki koi exempt income nahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya Section 263 ka revision chal sakta hai jab exempt income hi nahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT Hyderabad ne Section 263 revision radd kar diya. Bola ki 2022 ka amendment prospective hai aur bina exempt income ke Section 14A nahi lagta.
cases.takeaway: Exempt income na ho to AO Section 14A disallowance par Section 263 lagaye to usko challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Sanjay Kalsi Vs Central Circle-04 (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Sanjay Kalsi par Rs. 14.96 lakh ki Section 271DA penalty laga di gayi thi. Basis tha third party ki excel sheet entries aur department ne bola ki cash sales hui.
cases.issue: Kya sirf third party excel data par Section 271DA penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di. Bola ki bas kisi aur ki entry aur tax payment se cash sale prove nahi hota.
cases.takeaway: Agar department sirf doosre ke data par penalty laga raha hai, to strong defense ban sakta hai. Cash sales humesha documents se prove honi chahiye.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Reliance Industries Limited (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Reliance Industries ka amalgamation ka case tha. Department ne naye tax notice bheje the, jabki pehle Bombay High Court ne unki assessments radd kar di thi. Ab Revenue ne Supreme Court mein SLP file ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya revenue ki SLP valid hai jab fresh tax notice bheji gayi hai aur pehle assessments radd ho chuki thi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Revenue ki SLPs radd kar di. High Court ka faisla, jisme merged companies ki assessment radd ki thi, barkarar raha.
cases.takeaway: Agar High Court ne assessment radd kar di hai to department ko naye notice dene padenge. Purana assessment bach nahi sakta.

cases.case_name: Dossa Chemicals Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Company ne education cess aur 550 rupaye GST late fee deduction claim kiya tha, us par department ne 2.70 lakh ka penalty lagaya ki galat claim kiya gaya hai.
cases.issue: Kya pehle se HC ke ruling ke base par education cess ka deduction lene par penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki claim bona fide tha kyunki tab prevailing High Court ka ruling tha. Penalty hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar kisi cheez par HC ki ruling hai to uske hisaab se claim lene par penalty nahi banti. Apne claim ka base batao toh penalty se bach sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Prakash Chandra Dosi Vs ITO (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Assessee par 10 lakh rupaye ki unexplained investment ka addition lagaya gaya; basis tha ek unsigned land sale agreement aur stamp papers ki tarikh bhi match nahi hui.
cases.issue: Kya unsigned sale agreement par unexplained investment ka addition lag sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition ko hata diya. Bola unsigned agreement, contradictory dates aur koi corroboration nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Kisi bhi investment addition ko rokhne ke liye signed aur saboot wale agreement hone chahiye. Sirf unsigned paper nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: Sanjana Cryogenic Storages Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Assessee par 73.45 lakh ka Section 234D interest lagaya gaya. Matlab, reassessment ke baad interest charge kiya gaya jab ek pehle se regular assessment ho chuka tha.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment ke baad 234D interest lagaya ja sakta hai jab pehle Section 143(3) ka assessment ho chuka hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne interest ko hata diya. Bola pehle se regular assessment ho chuki thi, isliye phir se 234D nahi lag sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar ek baar regular assessment ho gaya hai to reassessment par 234D interest dobara nahi lagega. Notice ka type check karo.

cases.case_name: AEON Formulations Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Company ka limited scrutiny tha par AO ne R&D ka pura Section 35(2AB) ka issue bhi nikal liya aur 2.46 crore ka disallowance kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya limited scrutiny mein AO issue scope ke bahar ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Bola AO limited scrutiny ke bahar nahi ja sakta jab tak higher authority ki permission nahi le.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka case limited scrutiny ka hai, to AO sirf wahi points check karega jo notice mein hain. Agar usne scope cross kiya toh aap challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Excellent Polycon Private Limited Vs State Tax Officer (Calcutta High Court)
cases.facts: GST department ne penalty lagayi kyunki e-way bill expire ho gaya tha. Lekin saare genuine documents the aur koi tax evasion ka irada nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf expired e-way bill par penalty lag sakti hai jab koi tax evasion nahi hai?
cases.held: High Court ne penalty radd kar di. Bola jab sab documents the aur tax evasion ka proof nahi tha to penalty nahi banti.
cases.takeaway: E-way bill expire ho jaye lekin agar booking, invoice sab sahi hai aur koi chori nahi hai to penalty nahi lagegi. Documents hamesha saath rakho.

cases.case_name: Girik Estate Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Girik Estate Pvt. Ltd. ka case tha. ITO ne company ki reassessment start ki jabki income Rs.48.23 lakh thi. Appeal late file hui, par tribunal ne time condone kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya ITO proper power ke bina reassessment kar sakta tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne assessment radd kar diya. Reason tha ITO ke paas itni badi amount ka case lene ka jurisdiction nahi tha. Pecuniary jurisdiction follow nahi hua.
cases.takeaway: Agar officer ke paas aapke case ki limit ke hisaab se power nahi hai, toh pura assessment radd ho sakta hai. Jurisdiction object zarur uthaiye.

cases.case_name: Shukla Bholanath Rajpati Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Shukla Bholanath Rajpati ka case tha. Disputed addition Rs.35.81 crore ki thi. Pehle baar-baar non-compliance hua, fir bhi ek mauka aur diya.
cases.issue: Kya repeated non-compliance ke bawajood assessee ko ek aur chance milna chahiye?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition ki assessment file wapas department ko bhej di taaki fresh decision ho. Saath hi, Rs.1 lakh ki cost bhi lagayi assessee pe. Final mauka diya jo bhi compliance baaki hai, wo pura karein.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap baar-baar attendance miss karte hain to bhi ek mauka mil sakta hai, par penalty lag sakti hai. Har notice mein timely reply karna zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Jagadish Panchal Vs ADIT (TDS) (ITAT Jodhpur)
cases.facts: Jagadish Panchal ne property bechi thi. TDS nahi kata tha is property sale pe. Baad mein jab seller ne apni income disclose kar di aur Form 26A laga diya, toh penalty lagayi gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya agar seller ne income dikhayi aur Form 26A de diya, phir bhi TDS penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne Rs.1.12 lakh ki Section 271C penalty hata di. Bola income disclose ho gayi aur proper document diya toh penalty ki zarurat nahi.
cases.takeaway: Property sale ke baad agar Form 26A ke through income dikh gayi toh TDS penalty se bach sakte hain. Form 26A seller se time pe le lo.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Shri Aman Batra (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.facts: DCIT ne Aman Batra ke case me unaccounted sales pe zyada profit add kiya tha. Kuch addition Rs.2.25 crore unsupported tha. ITAT ne telescoping allow ki matlab ki purchases ki adjustment profit se kar li.
cases.issue: Kya unaccounted sales pe gross profit add karte waqt telescoping allow hota hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne extra gross profit restrict kar diya. Unsupported addition radd kar diya aur telescoping approve ki.
cases.takeaway: Unaccounted sales jab declare karo toh related purchases ki adjustment mang lo. Sirf ek hi income do jagah na add ho.

cases.case_name: Alka Ajit Shah Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Alka Ajit Shah ka case tha. Reassessment Rs.16.20 lakh ka tha. Department ne third-party search material ke basis pe case khola par section 153C ke process ko follow nahi kiya.
cases.issue: Kya third-party search ke basis pe bina section 153C follow kiye reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment khatam kar diya. Bola jab bhi third-party search material ho toh procedure section 153C ka follow karna padta hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case me kisi aur party ke search documents ki wajah se assessment khuli hai toh check karo section 153C ki procedure puri hui ya nahi.

cases.case_name: Amarjeet Singh Bhatia Vs ACIT-3(1) (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Amarjeet Singh Bhatia ka case me Rs.21.49 lakh ki reassessment DCIT/ACIT ne ki thi. Lekin CBDT instructions ke hisab se unke paas jurisdiction nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina proper pecuniary jurisdiction ke assessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment quash kar di. Bola DCIT/ACIT ke paas itni amount ka power nahi tha CBDT ke rules ke hisaab se.
cases.takeaway: Aapka case jis officer ke pass hai uski monetary limit check kar lo. Jurisdiction ka objection uthaoge to pura case khatam ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Smt. Kailashbai Manubhai Kahor Vs PCIT (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.section: Section 263 (Principal Commissioner ki revisionary power) aur Section 56(2)(vii)(b) (stamp value properties me difference)
cases.facts: Ek lady ke case me, Assessing Officer ne property ka stamp value difference properly check nahi kiya tha. Stamp value aur actual consideration me 30.84 lakh ka difference tha. PCIT ne AO ki order revise kar di ki AO ne galti se ignore kiya.
cases.issue: Kya AO ke examine na karne par revision ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola AO ne property ka stamp value difference examine nahi kiya, isliye PCIT ka Section 263 wala revision sahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar property transaction ho to AO ko stamp value vs actual price thoroughly check karna chahiye, warna case revise ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Banarsi Devi Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Banarsi Devi ko ek nayi Section 148 notice 25 July 2022 ko di gayi. Lekin law ke anusaar pehle wali notice ke sirf 7 din tak hi limitation rehti hai. Nayi notice 7 din se baad di gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya Section 148 reassessment notice time limit ke baad issue ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki 7 din baad notice out of time hai, isliye reassessment ko radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Section 148 notice ki timing dhyan se check karni chahiye. Agar 7 din se zyada ho gaya hai to reassessment illegal hai.

cases.case_name: Harvinder Singh Sehgal Vs ACIT (ITAT Guwahati)
cases.section: Section 271DA (cash transaction penalty) aur Section 269ST (cash receipt ka rule)
cases.facts: Harvinder Singh Sehgal par 5.68 crore ki penalty Section 271DA ke tahat lagayi gayi thi. Department cash receipt ka proof nahi de paya aur limitation period bhi cross ho gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya penalty lag sakti hai jab cash receipt ka proof nahi hai aur limitation period cross ho chuka hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty radd kar di kyunki department cash receipt prove nahi kar saka aur limitation period bhi nikal gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Section 271DA ki penalty tabhi valid hai jab cash receipt ka solid proof ho aur time par notice di gayi ho.

cases.case_name: Rajeshkumar Shah Vs ITO (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Rajeshkumar Shah ka case money-transfer business ka tha. Cash addition 2.49 lakh ka hua, lekin unhone customer details provide kar diye the.
cases.issue: Kya jab pura customer detail de diya hai to cash addition sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT Surat ne bola jab customer ka detail mil gaya hai to Section 68 ki addition radd kar di.
cases.takeaway: Money-transfer ya cash business me customer details, bank entry aur receipt sab record rakhna chahiye, taki cash credit ko explain kiya ja sake.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Mahendrakumar Varjangbhai Jilaria (ITAT Surat)
cases.section: Section 54F (capital gains deduction on house property)
cases.facts: Mahendrakumar ne apne capital gain pe Section 54F ka claim kiya. Unke paas vacant residential plots the. AO ne deduction roka tha, bola plot house nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya vacant residential plot ko residential house mana ja sakta hai Section 54F ke liye?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki vacant plot ko ghar nahi maana jayega. Jo land par timely construction hua hai, us par deduction milega.
cases.takeaway: Section 54F ka faayda tab milega jab aap ne vacant plot par naya ghar timely bana liya ho. Sirf plot par deduction nahi milega.

cases.case_name: Choice Estates And Constructions Private Limited Vs Union of India (Kerala High Court)
cases.facts: GST department ne ek hi composite show cause notice aur order issue kiya 2020-21 se 2022-23 tak ke liye. Taxpayer ne bola alag alag financial years ke liye alag notice deni chahiye thi.
cases.issue: Kya ek hi composite GST notice multiple years ke liye valid hai?
cases.held: Kerala High Court ne notice aur order ko radd kar diya. Bola ki har saal ke liye alag notice chahiye aur specified period limitation se bahar nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: GST me alag alag financial year ka notice alag alag dena padega. Single composite notice illegal hai.

cases.case_name: Praveen Khurana Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Ye case Praveen Khurana ka tha. Assessing Officer ne purane assessment ko wapas khol diya, sirf investigation ya verification ke liye. Unhone kaha capital loss aur US travel expenses par further jaanch chahiye.
cases.issue: Kya purane assessment ko sirf verification ya shak ki wajah se dobara khol sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment radd kar diya. Unhone bola, assessment wapas kholne ki wajah sirf verification thi, koi concrete evidence nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar AO bas shak pe ya sirf verification ki baat likh ke notice bheje, toh aap reassessment ko challenge kar sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Tata Steel Ltd Vs ACIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Tata Steel par ₹2,223 crore illegal mining ka addition lagaya gaya tha. Revenue ne keh diya ki mining illegal thi, isliye yeh addition kiya. Saath hi company ki Corus loan interest aur foreign loan transfer pricing pe bhi issue tha.
cases.issue: Kya illegal mining additions bina pucca evidence lag sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition radd kar diya. Bola, koi thos evidence nahi hai, isliye itna bada addition nahi chal sakta. Corus loan interest allow kar diya; foreign loan transfer pricing adjust nahi kiya.
cases.takeaway: Additions itne bade bina proper proof nahi ho sakte. Agar department khali shak ya andaz pe assessment kare, appeal karo.

cases.case_name: Commissioner of Central Tax And Others Vs Jeans Knit Private Limited (Karnataka High Court)
cases.facts: Jeans Knit Private Limited ko ₹29.61 crore ka GST refund milna tha. Department ne is par appeal ki, lekin appeal ki last date nikal chuki thi. Department ne bola ki audit aur internal note ki wajah se time extend hona chahiye.
cases.issue: Kya refund appeal mein limitation sirf departmental process se extend ho sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola, appeal ka limitation period Section 107 mein fixed hai. Department ki taraf se koi internal note ya audit time extend nahi kar sakta. Recovery wapas le li gayi, appeal time-barred thi.
cases.takeaway: GST refund recovery mein, agar department delay kare, toh aap appeals limitation check karo. Audit ki wajah se limitation extend nahi hota.

cases.case_name: Sharekhan Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Sharekhan Limited par ₹18.89 crore ki disallowance lagayi thi kyunki purane saal ke provisions reverse hue the. Saath hi ₹6.62 crore Section 14A (jo exempt income pe kharcha disallow karta hai) bhi disallow hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya earlier year provisions reverse hone pe income pe disallowance lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne disallowance hata di. Bola, provision reverse hone pe income taxable mani jaani chahiye, disallowance nahi ho sakti. 14A ki disallowance bhi hata di, par education cess disallowance banayi rakhi.
cases.takeaway: Provision reversal ya exempt income pe kharcha agar sahi proof ho toh aap apni favor mein ITAT tak ja sakte hain.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs L. Javerchand Jewellers Pvt. Ltd. (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Yahan jewellery business tha. AO ne estimated undisclosed jewellery income pe penalty notice diya tha, lekin clear nahi tha ki kis galti ke liye penalty hai.
cases.issue: Kya vague penalty notice pe Section 270A (misreporting pe penalty) lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di. Bola, agar penalty notice mein sahi charge nahi likha toh penalty nahi lag sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko penalty ka notice vague ya unclear aaye, toh turant object karo. Notice mein galti clear likhna zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Aananda Devcon Private Limited Vs ACIT (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Aananda Devcon ka assessment hua tha. Notice under Section 143(2) ITO ne diya tha, jabki unke paas itni badi assessment ka adhikar nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya ek wrong jurisdiction officer ka notice assessment ko invalid bana deta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne poora assessment radd kar diya. Bola, 143(2) ka notice sahi adhikar wale officer se hi aana chahiye tha.
cases.takeaway: Notice sirf sahi jurisdiction officer hi bhej sakta hai. Agar notice galat officer se aaye, toh poora assessment gir sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Harsh Estates Pvt. Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Harsh Estates Pvt. Ltd. ek real estate company hai. Unhone apne books mein interest ka kharcha claim kiya tha. Department ne interest capitalization ko lekar appeal ki, par group ke pehle ke judgments jaise hi yahan bhi deduction allow ho gayi.
cases.issue: Interest deduction aur uski capitalization sahi thi ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki pehle same group ke cases mein bhi deduction allow hua hai. Isliye yahan bhi interest expenditure allow kiya. Capitalisation appeals ko bhi kharij kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke group mein pehle se similar case decide ho chuka hai, toh uski copy judgments court ko dikhaiye. Similar ground par relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Agarwal Metcom Private Limited Vs ACIT/DCIT (ITAT Ranchi)
cases.facts: Agarwal Metcom ke khilaaf reassessment ki notice bheji gayi thi. Lekin department ne taxpayer ko Section 148A(b) ke tahat 7 clear din ka mauka nahi diya.
cases.issue: Kya bina poore 7 din notice diye reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki law ke mutabik 7 clear din notice jaruri hai. Notice me yeh poora samay nahi diya gaya tha, isliye reassessment aur Section 263 revision dono ko quash kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko reassessment ka notice mile to check karo ki poore 7 din diye gaye hain ya nahi. Kam hai to poori proceeding invalid ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Sudhir S. Mehta Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Sudhir S. Mehta ne interest ka kharcha, share purchase cost, household expenses aur TDS-adjusted statutory interest pe deduction ka claim kiya tha. Department ne inme se kuch ko mana kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya ye sab kharche aur deduction allow hone chahiye the?
cases.held: Court ne sabhi claims allow kar diye. Bola ki expenses genuine hai aur sahi tareeke se claim kiye gaye the.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap multiple genuine expenses claim kar rahe hain, toh sabhi relevant documents aur calculation ek jagah rakh ke file karo. Poore details se file karne par relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Juris Matrix Advisors Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Company ne ek property sale ki thi, jiska saara income pehle assessment year mein (2014-15) tax ke liye dikhaya tha. Department ne late registration hone ki wajah se 2016-17 mein fir se ₹93.34 lakh ka addition kiya.
cases.issue: Kya property registration late hone se taxability koi aur saal mein ho sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki jab sale complete ho chuki hai aur income pehle hi dikhaya ja chuka hai, toh late registration ki wajah se doosre saal fir se tax nahi lag sakta. Addition hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Property sale ki income jis saal sale complete hui usi mein dikhao. Registration delay par bhi double tax nahi lagta, magar transaction ka proof sambhal ke rakho.

cases.case_name: Cyqurex Systems Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Cyqurex Systems ne software kharche ka claim kiya tha, jo department ne disallow kar diya aur ₹1.24 crore penalty Section 270A (under-reporting of income) laga di.
cases.issue: Kya expenditure disallow hone par automatic penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki yeh bona fide claim tha aur taxpayer ne kharcha saaf-saaf dikhaya tha. Sirf claim disallow hone se penalty nahi lagni chahiye thi, penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar expense claim genuine aur pure disclosure ke saath ho, toh disallowance par bhi penalty nahi lagni chahiye. Claim karte waqt explanation aur supporting papers zarur file karo.

cases.case_name: Lakshmi Mohan Vs Airtech Projects Engineers Pvt. Ltd. & Anr. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: SARFAESI Act ke tahat auction hua tha, lekin bidder ka earnest money Rs. 35,000 kam tha. Auction ke baad property bech di gayi aur surplus paisa ka issue utha.
cases.issue: Kya EMD mein kam amount se auction radd hoga ya valid mana jayega?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne kaha ki Rs. 35,000 ki kami hone ke bawajood auction ko valid maana jayega. Par surplus proceeds ka refund 7% interest ke saath dena hoga.
cases.takeaway: SARFAESI auction mein chhota technical error ho toh bhi result valid ho sakta hai. Lekin extra paisa refund milne ki sambhavna hoti hai. Auction ke documents pr dhyan se verification karo.

cases.case_name: NRP Projects (P.) Ltd. Vs Additional/Joint/Deputy/ACIT/ITO (Madras High Court)
cases.facts: Ek dissolved partnership firm ke khilaaf reassessment kiya gaya tha. Usi PAN aur IEC records se company ke successor ki transactions sabit ho gayi thi.
cases.issue: Badi baat yeh thi: kya dissolved firm ke khilaaf reassessment sahi hai jab successor ka record alag hai?
cases.held: Court ne reassessment ko radd kar diya. Bola dissolved firm ka case kholne ka koi basis nahi jab successor entity ke records complete hain.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapki firm dissolve ho gayi hai aur nayi entity ban gayi hai toh apne sab financial records successor entity ke naam pe clear rakhna bahut zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: State of Gujarat Etc. Vs Choodamani Parmeshwaran Iyer & Anr. Etc. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Gujarat High Court ne GST ke arrest powers ko rok lagayi thi. Supreme Court ne yeh order radd kar diya.
cases.issue: Ye tha sawal: kya statutory arrest powers GST law me valid hain ya nahi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne bola ki GST me arrest ke powers hai aur High Court ki protection galat thi. Har assessee ko inquiry me fully cooperate karna chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST department se summon ya inquiry aaye toh puri tarah cooperate karo. Arrest ke full powers hai authorities ke paas.

cases.case_name: Sudhir S. Mehta Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Sudhir Mehta par unexplained share investment ka allegation tha. Department ne koi thos evidence nahi diya. Third party ki evidence bhi undisclosed thi.
cases.issue: Kya bina proper evidence ke share investment add kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Bola bina direct evidence aur assessee ko mauka diye income add nahi kar sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar department koi addition sirf suspicion pe kare toh evidence ki copy zaroor mangwao aur challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Neetu M. Chandaliya Vs ITO (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: 14 logon ko reassessment notice mila. Basis tha cash deposit aur dusre department se li hui info.
cases.issue: Kya sirf suspicion aur dusre ki satisfaction pe case khola ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Bombay HC ne sare notices radd kiye. Bola independent reason nahi tha, sirf dusre se liye data par nahi khol sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko reassessment notice mile aur sirf generic info cite ho toh detail me enquiry ka letter mangwao ya notice challenge karo.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs IndusInd Bank Ltd. (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Reassessment notice bina DIN (Document Identification Number) ke diya gaya. Baad me department ne intimation bheja ki DIN allot kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina DIN ke reassessment valid hai ya baad me fix ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne notice ko radd kiya. Bola bina DIN ke initial notice valid nahi, baad ka intimation kaam nahi aata.
cases.takeaway: Koi bhi assessment, notice ya order dekho toh sabse pehle usme DIN check karo. Bina DIN ke notice milte hi object karo.

cases.case_name: Smt. Shashi Jain Vs PCIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Property agreement 2008 ka tha. 263 revision iss base par kiya gaya ki stamp duty value aur agreement value me difference tha.
cases.issue: Kya purane property agreement par amended Section 56 (property valuation difference) lagu hota hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne revision radd ki. Bola agreement amendment ke pehle ka hai isliye Section 56 apply nahi hota.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka property agreement purana hai toh us par nayi amendment wale section nahi lagenge. Agreement ki date clear dikhana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Datta s/o Sakharam Kothule Vs State of Maharashtra (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Cooperative bank ki property auction hui thi. Auction ke baad kisi aur ne higher bid diya aur kuch irregularities ka allegation hua.
cases.issue: Kya auction ke baad kisi ki higher bid ya irregularity allegation par property sale cancel ho sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola auction process sahi tha. Late aayi bid ya vague complaints par sale dobara open nahi ki ja sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar bank property auction me participate karna hai toh proper time pe bid karo. Auction khatam hone ke baad challenge mushkil hai.

cases.case_name: Biswas Mohd Sher Ali Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Yeh case ek human hair trading ka tha. Department ne bank deposit ko unexplained money maan ke Section 69A ka notice diya. Court ko business receipt aur us se judi expenses par doubt tha.
cases.issue: Kya bank deposit ko unexplained income maana ja sakta hai jab business receipts ka linkage clear nahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas assessment officer ko bhej diya. Unhone bola ki sari receipts aur expenses ki detail check karni padegi sach jaanne ke liye.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke business ki receipts bank mein deposit ho rahi hain to har transaction ke expenses ka linkage taiyar rakho. Assessment ke time poora trail dikhana padega.

cases.case_name: Bihar Medical Services & Infrastructure Corporation Ltd. Vs Assessment Unit (ITAT Patna)
cases.facts: Yaha ₹84.92 crore GST expense claim ka case tha. Department ne claim ko allow nahi kiya kyunki accounting records aur documentary proof mein kami thi.
cases.issue: GST ke kharchon ki reconciliation aur documentation sahi hai ya nahi, yahi sawal tha.
cases.held: ITAT ne matter wapas officer ko bhej diya. Bola ki sari reconciliation aur documentary evidence fresh check karo.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap bade GST kharche claim kar rahe ho to har bill aur reconciliation paper sahi se rakhna. Assessment mein yahi papers kaam aayenge.

cases.case_name: Bhinaswar Commercial Pvt. Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Iss case mein DCIT ne reassessment shuru kar diya tha, lekin CBDT ke rule ke hisab se unke paas itna jurisdiction nahi tha. Company ne point uthaya ki officer galat tahat kaam kar raha hai.
cases.issue: Kya officer ko CBDT instruction violate karke reassessment ka right tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne pura reassessment process radd kar diya. Bola ki jab pecuniary jurisdiction nahi hai to action valid nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Hamesha CBDT ke instruction check karo. Agar officer ka jurisdiction nahi hai to unka notice valid nahi hai.

cases.case_name: Vinay Iron Foundry Vs PCIT (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: PCIT ne ₹12.50 crore bogus purchases par revision kiya tha section 263 ke andar. Lekin foundry ne bola ki original assessment mein sab cheezein submit ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya revision authority ko itna power hai jab asli assessment mein sab records the?
cases.held: ITAT ne PCIT ka revision order radd kar diya, bola ki sab pehle hi check ho chuka hai. Dusra assessment year ke loan dispute ko verification ke liye department ko wapas bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka case pehle hi saari details ke saath assess ho chuka hai to revision notice ko defend kar sakte ho. Nayi cheez nahi milegi to PCIT ka order tik nahi paayega.

cases.case_name: State Bank of India Vs ITO (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: SBI par foreign LFC payments par TDS default ka notice aya tha. Par Madras High Court ne pehle hi instruction de diya tha ki aise payments mein koi TDS nahi katega jab tak direction hai.
cases.issue: Kya Madras High Court ke protection ke baad TDS demand lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne saari TDS demands hata di. Bola jab tak court ka direction hai tab tak department interest ya penalty nahi maang sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar kisi court ka saf direction aa chuka hai to wahi follow karo. Department extra tax ya interest nahi maang sakta.

cases.case_name: Carborandum Universal Ltd. Vs ESI Corporation (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: ESI department ne contribution ka demand raise kiya tha kyunki company ke records poore nahi the. Lekin employer poora cooperation de raha tha apni taraf se.
cases.issue: Kya bas records thode adhure hone se demand barqaraar rahegi jab employer fully cooperate kare?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne ESI ka demand radd kar diya. Bola ki sirf inadequate records hone se, jab company cooperation kar rahi hai, department demand nahi rakh sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap ESI inspection mein cooperate kar rahe ho par koi record miss ho gaya hai to demand tik nahi paayegi. Lekin cooperation dikhana zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Suvarnakarara Cooperative Society Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Panaji)
cases.section: Section 80P (ye section cooperative society ko interest income par deduction deta hai)
cases.facts: Suvarnakarara Cooperative Society ne apne business ke liye Union Bank mein deposits dale the. Department ne is deposit ki interest income par deduction deny kiya.
cases.issue: Kya cooperative society ko business deposits par bank interest income par Section 80P deduction milega?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola Section 80P deduction allowed hai. Business chalane ke liye bank deposit par interest mila to ye eligible hai.
cases.takeaway: Cooperative societies agar business ke liye bank deposit karte hain to uska interest bhi Section 80P mein deduction milega. Sirf investment nahi, business wali deposit bhi count hogi.

cases.case_name: Sagarmal Mall Vs DCIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Sagarmal Mall ne 19.80 lakh declare kiye. DCIT ne assessment kiya. Jurisdiction ka paisa limit cross ho gaya tha, jisme DCIT ko assessment karne ka haq nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya DCIT ne sahi jurisdiction mein assessment kiya tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola DCIT ko paisa limit ki wajah se assessment ka right nahi tha, isi liye assessment ko wapas bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Hammesha check karo ki jo AO assessment kar raha hai uske paas paisa limit ki wajah se jurisdiction hai ya nahi, especially agar case bada hai.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Layer Exports Pvt. Ltd. (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Layer Exports Pvt. Ltd. par department ne extra paisa (on-money) add kar diya, sirf loose papers ke basis par. Company construction business mein thi.
cases.issue: Kya sirf loose papers par on-money addition sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola loose papers ki koi value nahi, bina proper proof ke on-money addition nahi ho sakta. Company ka project completion account bhi check kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar sirf loose papers milte hain bina kisi proof ke, to us par addition nahi ho sakta. Documents aur accounts solid hone chahiye.

cases.case_name: Elegant Vinimay Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.section: Section 151A (faceless scheme start hone ki date ka issue tha)
cases.facts: NFAC ne 2012-13 ka assessment faceless scheme ke through kiya, lekin vo scheme tab active nahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya faceless assessment sahi thi jab Section 151A ka scheme operational hi nahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola section 151A scheme jab tak notify nahi hui thi, tab tak uske under assessment karna galat hai. Assessment radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Faceless assessments sirf tabhi valid hain jab scheme ki date ke baad ho. Old date ka case traditional AO ko hi karna hai.

cases.case_name: Mathialagan Gathya Vs DDIT/ADIT (Investigation) (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Mathialagan ka Sweden se salary income tha, jis par Indian department ne Black Money Act ke tahat addition kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Sweden se salary ko Indian Black Money Act mein addition kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT Chennai ne addition hata diya, kyunki detection-year aur India–Sweden tax treaty ki wajah se assessment valid nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Foreign salary income par agar India–Sweden DTAA apply hota hai, to black money addition automatically sahi nahi hota. Double tax avoid karna padta hai.

cases.case_name: Shantanu Bhowmick Vs ADIT (Investigation) (ITAT Delhi)
cases.section: Black Money Act, section 10(1) (ye notice assessment shuru karne ke liye hota hai)
cases.facts: Department ne Shantanu par ₹2.04 crore ki Black Money Act assessment aur ₹1.84 crore penalty lagayi, lekin sahi notice issue nahi kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina valid notice ke assessment aur penalty Black Money Act mein lag sakta hai?
cases.held: Delhi ITAT ne bola bina valid notice assessment hi nahi lag sakti, penalty bhi radd ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Black Money Act ki assessment shuru hone se pehle, bina sahi section 10(1) notice ke pura action invalid ho jata hai. Notice check karwa lo.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Growmore Research & Assets Management Ltd. (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Ye ek company ka case tha jisko Income Tax department ne Section 148 ka notice diya. Notice mein bola ke return 'within 30 days' file karo. Assessee ne bola ki notice galat hai.
cases.issue: Kya Section 148 ka notice 'within 30 days' likhne se valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT Mumbai ne bola ki notice galat hai, kyunki law mein 'within 30 days' nahi bola. Iss wajah se pura reassessment radd kar diya. Revenue ki cross-appeal bhi kharij ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Section 148 notice jab bhi aaye to language check karo. Agar 'within 30 days' likha hai to challange kiya ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Deepika A Mehta Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Yahan ek individual taxpayer ka case tha. Uske accounts audit nahi hue the. Income Tax department ne sirf non-audit hone ki wajah se books reject kar diye aur investments ko unexplained maan liya.
cases.issue: Kya sirf audit nahi hone ki wajah se books reject kar sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola sirf audit non-compliance par books reject nahi ho sakti jab tak koi kami ya defect na ho. Isliye department ke unexplained investments aur dusre addition hata diye.
cases.takeaway: Agar books audit nahi hui hain lekin defects nahi mile to department addition nahi kar sakta.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Shashi Kant Tulsian (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Shashi Kant Tulsian ne short term capital gain (STCG) dikhaya jo Section 111A ke under tha. Revenue ne bola Section 87A ki rebate nahi mil sakti.
cases.issue: Kya Section 111A STCG par Section 87A ki ₹25,000 tak rebate mil sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne bola Section 87A rebate allowed hai STCG par jo Section 111A ke under aata hai. Revenue ki appeal kharij ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar STCG Section 111A par taxable hai to Section 87A ki rebate claim kar sakte ho, even for current years.

cases.case_name: Smt. Seema Daga Vs ITO (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Smt. Seema Daga ka reopening notice 25.07.2022 ko issue hua tha. Department ne TOLA ke through limitation extend karke notice diya. Assessee ne bola limitation expire ho chuki thi.
cases.issue: Kya notice limitation period khatam hone ke baad valid hai jab TOLA apply nahi karta?
cases.held: ITAT Raipur ne reopening notice ko radd kar diya kyunki limitation khatam ho chuki thi aur TOLA yahan apply nahi hota tha.
cases.takeaway: Section 148 notice jab bhi aaye to check karo ki limitation period abhi valid hai ya expire ho chuka hai, specially TOLA cases mein.

cases.case_name: Kamaljeet Singh Vs ACIT (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.facts: Kamaljeet Singh par ₹32.40 lakh penalty Section 270A mein lagayi gayi. Department ki notice mein clear nahi tha ki galti under-reporting hai ya misreporting.
cases.issue: Kya vague notice par Section 270A penalty lag sakti hai jab exact charge nahi likha?
cases.held: ITAT Chandigarh ne penalty ko radd kiya, kyunki notice mein kis base par penalty lagani hai wo clear nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Penalty notice aane par dekho ki notice mein clear likha hai ya nahi - under-reporting ya misreporting. Vague notice aayi to challenge karo.

cases.case_name: DivyaLok Co-operative Group Housing Society Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Yahan ek housing society ka penalty case tha. Assessment unit ne Section 271D ki penalty lagayi jabki Faceless Penalty Unit kaam kar raha tha.
cases.issue: Kya assessment unit penalty laga sakti hai jab Faceless Penalty Unit operational ho chuki ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty quash kar di, kyunki assessment unit ke paas ab jurisdiction nahi tha. Faceless Penalty Unit hi penalty laga sakti thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar Faceless Penalty Unit start ho chuki hai, toh old assessing officer ki penalty order challenge kar sakte ho for lack of jurisdiction.

cases.case_name: Styrenix Performance Materials Limited Vs ACIT (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Styrenix Performance Materials Limited ka TP adjustment intra-group services par ₹20.18 crore laga diya gaya tha. Company ne Gujarat High Court ka purana order dikhaya jisme same facts par relief mila tha.
cases.issue: Kya intra-group services par lagaya TP adjustment sahi tha jab pehle High Court isi mudde par relief de chuka hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne pura TP adjustment hata diya. Gujarat High Court ke pehle wale faisle ko follow kiya kyunki facts same the.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case ke facts kisi purane High Court ke ruling ke same hain, to wo ruling aapke kaam aa sakti hai, especially TP adjustments mein.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Daljeet Singh (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.facts: Daljeet Singh par allegation tha ki usne property purchase mein ₹91.11 lakh cash diye, lekin yeh sirf ek third-party document par based tha. Cross-examination ka mauka bhi nahi diya gaya.
cases.issue: Kya bina reliable proof ke, sirf third-party paper par cash addition kar sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne cash addition hata diya. Cross-examination nahi hua tha aur record bhi confirmed nahi the.
cases.takeaway: Sirf third-party papers ya statements se cash addition nahi ho sakta, jab tak aapko cross-examine karne ka mauka na mile.

cases.case_name: Vijay Agarwal Vs DCIT (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: Vijay Agarwal ke case mein ITAT ne jewellery kazyada addition hata diya par ₹20 lakh cash ka addition banaya rakha. Soni Jewellers ki valuation ki baat wapas department ko verify karne bhej di.
cases.issue: Kya jewellery addition ke saath cash addition bhi justify tha?
cases.held: Jewellery addition hata diya, ₹20 lakh cash addition confirm kiya aur kuch points department ko wapas jaane diye verification ke liye.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke against cash ya jewellery ka addition ho, to proof aur valuation paper clear rakkho. Verification ka mauka mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Bhimji Bhikhabhai Tukadiya Vs ITO (ITAT Rajkot)
