cases.facts: BSNL ke VRS-2019 scheme par 10 retired staff ki exemption claim CIT(A) ne scheme ki details verify kiye bina radd kar di thi.
cases.issue: Kya CIT(A) ko Central Government approved VRS scheme ki janch karni chahiye thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne matter wapas bhej diya, kaha scheme ki detail janch ke bina exemption decide nahi ki ja sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap VRS ke basis par exemption le rahe hain, to department ko scheme ka full detail dena zaroori hai. Verification ho toh proof ready rakhna.

cases.facts: Directors ne apne funds ke source proof ke paper diye. Department unko properly rebut nahi kar saka. ₹17.46 crore ka addition balance sheet mein unexplained tha.
cases.issue: Kya jab directors source ka evidence de dein aur department uska jawab na de, tabhi addition chal sakta hai?
cases.held: Addition hata diya kyunki directors ke papers par specific objection nahi diya gaya.
cases.takeaway: Aapko jo paisa share capital/proprietor ke naam dikhaye, uska full proper document rakkho. Department object kare to specific jawab do.

cases.facts: Ek taxpayer ka GST appeal High Court ne radd kar diya tha. Supreme Court ne interfere nahi kiya, par limitation (last date) appeal file karne ki extend kar di till 16 October 2026.
cases.issue: Kya High Court ke order ke baad bhi Supreme Court time extend kar sakta hai GST appeal ke liye?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne order diya ki limitation ab 16 October 2026 tak extend ho gayi hai, taki taxpayer appeal kar sake.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka GST appeal time-bar ho gaya hai lekin Supreme Court extension de de, to extension ke dauraan appeal file zaroor kar dena.

cases.facts: Revenue ne bogus purchase disallowance par 6% se jyada add karne ki koshish ki thi. Supreme Court ne Gujarat High Court ka order, jo sirf 6% par rokta hai, ke against SLP radd kar diya.
cases.issue: Bogus purchase par kitna percent disallowance reasonable hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Revenue ki appeal radd kar di, aur High Court ka 6% ka limit barkarar rakha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap ke books mein bogus purchase ka issue hai, to department 6% se jyada add nahi kar sakta, provided facts same ho.

cases.case_name: Dineshbhai Parmar Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Dineshbhai Parmar ne property mein ₹1.82 lakh invest kiye. Department ne poocha paisa kahan se aaya. Assessee ne bola purani savings se kiya hai.
cases.issue: Kya property investment mein jo paisa laga wo unexplained income hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Bola ki chhoti amount hai, purani savings se aana normal hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar investment ka source normal household savings ho aur amount chhota ho, to records dikhana kaafi hai.

cases.case_name: Anjani Kumar Sinha Vs Union of India (Patna High Court)
cases.facts: Anjani Kumar Sinha ka GST assessment bina sunwai ke ho gaya. Notice sirf speed post se bheja, koi proof nahi ki mila.
cases.issue: Kya notice bhejne bhar se service maan li jayegi?
cases.held: Court ne assessment radd kar diya. Bola sirf dispatch se service nahi mani ja sakti. Proof dikhana zaroori hai.
cases.takeaway: GST notice serve karne par delivery ka proper proof rakhna zaroori hai. Bina proof ke assessment tick nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: Olympus Medical Systems Pvt. Ltd Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Company ka final assessment aaya, lekin department ne DRP ki directions ignore kar di aur wahi pehle wala order repeat kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya AO bina DRP ki baat maane assessment kar sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne final assessment radd kar diya. Bola DRP ki directions binding hai, unhe ignore nahi kar sakte.
cases.takeaway: DRP ka order AO ko follow karna hi padta hai. Agle assessment mein DRP points ko letter mein include karo.

cases.case_name: Trimble Information Technologies India Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Company ki AE se receivables par department ne ₹50.79 lakh ka TP adjustment kiya. Revenue ne bola credit period zyada diya gaya hai.
cases.issue: Kya AE ko zyada credit dene par TP adjustment sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne adjustment hata diya. Bola, contract ka credit period disturb nahi kiya ja sakta jab tak commercial reason hai.
cases.takeaway: Related party transactions mein agar contract ke hisab se credit hai, to department usme interfere nahi karega.

cases.case_name: Ramsingbhai (Ramsangbhai) Jerambhai Vs State of Gujarat and Another (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Land acquire hone ke baad kuch logon ne payment badhane ke liye court gaye. Unhone appellate court ke decision par fir se redetermination maanga.
cases.issue: Kya Section 28A ki redetermination appellate court ke order ke base par ho sakti hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne bola, redetermination sirf Reference Court ke award par ho sakti hai, appellate judgment par nahi.
cases.takeaway: Land acquisition mein compensation badhwana hai to Reference Court ke order ka hi sahara lena chahiye, appellate Court ke judgment se nahi milega.

cases.case_name: State Bank of India Vs ACIT (TDS) (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: SBI ne employees ko foreign travel LTC diya. Uspar TDS nahi kaata. Department ne demand raise kiya.
cases.issue: Kya foreign trip LTC par TDS lagta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne SBI ko assessee-in-default mana. Bola, foreign travel LTC par TDS kaatna tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar employee ko foreign travel LTC reimburse kar rahe ho to TDS kaatna compulsory hai, warna penalty lagegi.

cases.case_name: Chandraprabhu Digamber Jain Mandir Vs CIT (Exemption) (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Trust ko Section 12AB registration mili thi. Department ne usme condition laga di ki agar Supreme Court kuch aur bol de to benefits wapas le lenge.
cases.issue: Kya registration ko future court decision ke sath conditional bana sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne condition hata di. Bola, Supreme Court ke possible decision ka wait karke registration hold par nahi rakh sakte.
cases.takeaway: Section 12AB registration sirf act ke rules par milti hai, future case outcome ke base par nahi. Assured benefits milne chahiye.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Artline Vinimay Private Limited (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Rajyog Buildtech ke against main addition fail ho gayi thi. Artline Vinimay Pvt Ltd ke upar ₹2.44 crore ki protective addition lagi thi. Assessment banate waqt department ne backup ke liye yeh addition lagayi thi.
cases.issue: Jab main addition delete ho gayi, kya protective addition baki reh sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT Delhi ne bola jab main (substantive) addition delete ho gayi to protective wala apne aap gir jaata hai. Protective addition waisa hi hota hai, backup plan ki tarah.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein protective addition hai aur main wala hat gaya hai, to aapko usko bhi challenge karna chahiye. Waisa hi logic lagta hai.

cases.case_name: Mudita Chaturvedi Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Mudita Chaturvedi ki jewellery pakdi gayi thi – 719 gram. Assessing Officer ne isko unexplained bol diya aur Section 69 se income maan li, par family ka status shadi-shuda aur society mein theek tha.
cases.issue: Kya itni jewellery ko unexplained maan sakte hain ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT Delhi ne bola ki family ka status aur shadi-vivah ke mauke pe itni jewellery reasonable hai. Section 69 addition hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar jewellery ka weight family status aur rishton ke hisaab se sahi hai to us par addition nahi ho sakti. Achhe se explain/justify kar do ki kis kaunsa function tha.

cases.case_name: PCIT Vs Sheetal Dushyant Chaturvedi (Supreme Court)
cases.facts: Department ne return reopen kiye sirf isliye kyunki kuch papers aur transactions verify karne the. Is wajah se Bombay HC ne reopening ko radd kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Sirf verification ke liye case dobara kholna sahi hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne department ki appeal nai suni. Iska matlab Bombay HC ka faisla barkarar raha—matlab sirf verify karne ke liye Section 147 se dobara assessment nahi khol sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar sirf document verify karne ka reason diya hai, to reopening ko appeal mein challenge kar sakte ho. Reason must be specific—not only 'verification'.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Suraj Somaru Varma (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Suraj Somaru Varma ka paisa bank mein deposit hua tha—₹2.48 crore. Department ne pucha yeh paisa kahan se aaya. Unhone bataya ki money transfer business se paisa aaya aur puri reconciliation di.
cases.issue: Kya unexplained credit ko Section 68 se add kiya jaa sakta hai jab paisa explain ho gaya ho?
cases.held: ITAT Mumbai ne bola paisa banking channel se aaya, sab chizein reconcile ho gayi toh Section 68 addition galat thi. Addition hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Money transfer business ya cash credit ho to transaction ki puri detail, bank trail aur reconciliation files ready rakhni chahiye. Yeh court mein kaam aata hai.

cases.case_name: Shriganesh Kirana Pvt. Ltd. Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Company ne ₹1.40 crore loan liya tha. Department ne isko fake loan samjha kyunki lender par entry operator ka chhapa tha. Company ne lender ki ID, creditworthiness aur loan ki asliyat dikhayi.
cases.issue: Kya jab lender genuine hai to Section 68 addition lag sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola jab identity, paisa source aur loan original dikh gaya to bas entry operator ki wajah se loan fake nahi ho jaata. Addition hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap loan le rahe ho to lender ki puri detail, bank statement, aur confirmatory letter ready rakhni chahiye. Sirf suspicion se addition nahi lagti.

cases.case_name: Abhishek Jayraj Karnani Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Abhishek Karnani ne political party ko donation ki deduction mangi thi, baad mein withdraw kar li. Department ne misreporting ke liye ₹3.12 lakh penalty lagayi.
cases.issue: Kya withdraw ki gayi deduction claim ke liye penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT Ahmedabad ne bola jab claim withdraw kar li aur koi fraud nahi, to is basis par penalty nahi lagti. Sirf deduction lene ki koshish penalty ka reason nahi banti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapne election donation par deduction galti se claim kar li aur baad mein hata li, to department har case mein penalty nahi laga sakta. Intent aur evidence maangte hain.

cases.case_name: Lakhmanbhai Maru Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Lakhmanbhai Maru ne TDS credit agle year mein lene ki koshish ki jab deduction pichle year mein thi. Department ne ₹1.83 lakh ka credit dene se mana kar diya. Last saal ka refund claim abhi bhi pending hai.
cases.issue: Kya TDS credit galat year mein mil sakta hai jab refund pending hai?
cases.held: ITAT Ahmedabad ne bola ke TDS credit wahi mil sakta hai jis saal ka deduction hai. Refund claim alag issue hai, TDS galat year mein adjust nahi hoga.
cases.takeaway: TDS certificate ki details check kar lo. Jis saal ka deduction hai, sirf usi mein credit milega. Galat year mein mat file karo.

cases.case_name: Neelam Singh Vs ITO (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: Neelam Singh ek teacher hai. Department ne property purchase mein unki savings aur Khadar land ki condition par doubt uthaya. Section 69 (jo unexplained investment pe lagta hai) aur Section 56(2)(x) (gift/value pe tax) ke additions kiye gaye.
cases.issue: Kya property additions sahi hain jab taxpayer ki savings aur land ki quality ki verification pending hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas AO ko bhej diya. Kaha teacher ki savings aur Khadar land ki asli condition ka proper verification ho.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap land ya property purchase justify kar rahe hain, to apne saving sources aur property ki real condition ki saari details ready rakho. Assessment mein yeh documents maange ja sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Pooja Swami Vs Assessment Unit (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: Pooja Swami par ₹29.34 crore ka Bitcoin aur bank credit addition lag gaya. CIT(A) ne reasoned order nahi diya, seedha addition confirm kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya bina speaking order ke aise badi amount ka addition sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas bheja. Bola ki CIT(A) ko reason ke saath proper speaking order pass karna chahiye tha.
cases.takeaway: Aapke case ka order reasoned ho - har important addition pe CIT(A) ya AO ko reason likhna zaruri hai. Agar nahi hai to aap challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: KLSR Infratech Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: KLSR Infratech Limited par unexplained money (Section 69A) aur unexplained expenditure (Section 69C) ke additions lagaye gaye. Company ne FDR interest pe Section 80IA (infrastructure projects ko milne wali deduction) claim ki.
cases.issue: Kya unexplained expenditure additions aur FDR interest deduction allowed hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne dono additions hata diye. Company ko FDR interest pe Section 80IA deduction mil sakta hai, lekin verification pending hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar FDR interest pe Section 80IA claim kar rahe ho, to bank se proper certificate aur supporting documents ready rakho verification ke liye.

cases.case_name: Skill Promoters Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Skill Promoters pe kai penalty orders lagaye gaye, lekin Assessing Officer ne exactly specify nahi kiya ki kis charge pe penalty hai - concealment, misreporting ya kuch aur.
cases.issue: Kya penalty bina specify kiye lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne sari penalties hata di, kyunki charge specify nahi hua tha. Law kehta hai, penalty lagani hai to charge clear mention karo.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko penalty notice mile aur wahan clearly nahi likha ki kis wajah se penalty lag rahi hai, to aap us penalty ko challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Lakhmanbhai Maru Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Lakhmanbhai Maru ne ₹1.83 lakh ka TDS credit AY 2024-25 mein claim kiya. Par yeh deduction pehle saal (AY 2023-24) ka tha. Purana refund claim abhi tak pending tha.
cases.issue: Kya galat year mein TDS credit mil sakta hai jab original refund claim pending hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha, galat year mein TDS credit nahi diya ja sakta. Purane saal ke refund claim ko department dekh raha hai, naye saal mein credit nahi milegi.
cases.takeaway: Jo bhi TDS hai, usi assessment year mein claim karo jisme deduction hua. Galat year mein daaloge to credit nahi milegi, chahe refund abhi pending ho.

cases.case_name: Yogeshkumar Kasturji Prapapati Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Section 148 (reopening notice) baad mein issue hua, jab limitation period Section 149 ke hisaab se khatam ho gaya tha. PCIT ki approval bhi late mili.
cases.issue: Kya limitation period khatam hone ke baad notice valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne notice ko radd kar diya. Bola, limitation over hone ke baad approval lene se notice valid nahi hota.
cases.takeaway: Aapko agar reopening notice milta hai, to check karo date kis din serve hui. Limitation period khatam ho gaya ho to aap notice radd karwa sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Krunal Bharat Bhavsar Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Krunal Bharat Bhavsar ki car ki purchase pe department ne ₹6.35 lakh unexplained investment add kar diya. Dealer ne bataya ki paisa customer funds se hi diya gaya aur margin sirf ₹25,000 thi.
cases.issue: Kya customer ke paise se payment karne par Section 69 addition lag sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Bola dealer ne apni earning aur transaction ki details clear dikha di thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap car dealer ho, to customer ka paisa, margin aur payment ki full trail bank statement aur bill se dikha pao. Tabhi Section 69 ka addition nahi lagega.

cases.case_name: RNT Metals Pvt Ltd Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Company ka case tha. Assessing Officer ne Section 148 ka notice diya, par sahi samay nahi diya reply ke liye. Bogus purchase aur cash seize kiye the.
cases.issue: Section 148 ka short notice dena theek tha ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne reopening quash kar diya kyunki notice mein kam samay diya gaya tha. Sirf 5% bogus purchases (total amount mein se) hi add ki allowed.
cases.takeaway: Agar AO ne Section 148 ka notice diya lekin proper time nahi diya reply ka, to pura case radd ho sakta hai. Bogus purchase accusation mein khud ke documents dikhana zaroori hai. Sirf thoda hi addition ho sakta hai, pura nahi.

cases.case_name: Tvl A D Creation Vs State Tax Officer (Madras High Court)
cases.facts: Tvl A D Creation ka GST order pass hua bina personal hearing ke. Company ne reply file kiya tha, fir bhi koi sunwai nahi hui.
cases.issue: Kya reply ke baad bina personal hearing ke GST order pass ho sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne order radd kar diya kyunki proper sunwai nahi hui. Case department ko wapas bhej diya, par company ko 25% tax deposit karna padega.
cases.takeaway: Agar department aapki reply ke baad bhi bina bulaye order pass kare to High Court mein challenge kar sakte hain. Personal hearing har taxpayer ka adhikar hai.

cases.case_name: Sonali Sonu Sood Vs ACIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Sonali Sood par Rs. 76 lakh loan addition ho gayi. Department ne addition kiya bina cross-examination diye. Section 148 jurisdiction bhi dispute pe tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina cross-examination add ki gayi loan amount valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition AO ko wapas bhej di taaki cross-examination aur inquiry ho sake. Section 148 ke mamle khule chhode.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke khilaaf bina poori inquiry ya cross-examination ke addition ho jaye to aap ITAT mein remand ki demand kar sakte hain. Documents aur evidence dikhana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Coimbatore Pioneer Trading & Warehousing Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Company ne property becha tha. Sale consideration registration se pehle hi fix ho gayi thi. Board resolution, bank advance, aur BIFR proceedings sab lagaye the.
cases.issue: Kya Section 50C se addition ho sakti hai jab sale value registration se pehle decide ho gayi ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne section 50C ka addition hata diya kyunki pehle hi evidence se price decide ho gayi thi. Registration date se nahi dekhenge.
cases.takeaway: Agar property ka rate registration se pehle board resolution, bank se proof, ya BIFR approval me hai to Section 50C ke daayre se bach sakte hain. Poora documentary proof dikhana padega.

cases.case_name: Brij Bihari Kaushik Vs ACIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Businessman ke case mein 8% purchase ka addition aur Rs. 22 lakh Section 69A addition lagayi gayi thi. Purchases ko WhatsApp chat ke base par fake bola gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya WhatsApp chats pe genuine purchases ko bogus manna sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola WhatsApp se kuch prove nahi hota jab tak actual documents hai. 8% addition aur Section 69A addition dono hata di.
cases.takeaway: Purchase transactions mein actual bill aur payment proof rakho. Sirf online chat ke base par addition nahi lag sakti.

cases.case_name: Fine Arts Society Vs Deputy Director of Income Tax (Exemptions) 1-2 & Ors. (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Department ne reopening kiya jabki pehle Section 143(3) ka order ya Supreme Court ka judgment sahi se check nahi kiya tha. Galat facts par case khola.
cases.issue: Kya reopening galat ya adhuri info par ki ja sakti hai?
cases.held: High Court ne reopening radd kar di. Bola, department ne galti se facts misread kiye, reopening ka reason valid nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar AO galat facts par case kholta hai, to aap High Court mein reopening challenge kar sakte hain. Reason ke document check karo.

cases.case_name: JSW Steel Limited Vs Deputy Director (Karnataka High Court)
cases.facts: JSW Steel ne PMLA case ko quash karne ki maang ki thi. Company ka kehna tha ki pehle se hi kuch issues court ne dekh liye hain. Special Judge ne summons nikaale the aur cognizance liya tha.
cases.issue: Kya PMLA ki proceedings pehle wale issues par quash ki ja sakti hain?
cases.held: Court ne kaha ki jo issues pehle consider ho chuke hain, un basis par PMLA ki proceedings quash nahi ho sakti. Special Judge ka order sahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par PMLA case chal raha hai, to sirf is wajah se ki kuch points pehle hi dekhe gaye the, proceedings quash nahi hongi. Har baar naye grounds chahiye hote hain.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Travel Designer India Pvt. Ltd. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Income Tax Department ne SLP file ki thi Section 143(2) notice ki limitation par. Department ko notice serve karne mein late ho gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya limitation ke bahar notice diya gaya to assessment ho sakta hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Revenue ki SLP dismiss kar di, par sawal ko open chhoda ki limitation legal point ka kya hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko time ke baad Section 143(2) ka notice aaye to aap challenge kar sakte ho. Supreme Court ne is mudde pe abhi final decision nahi diya hai.

cases.case_name: Giriraj Enterprises Vs DCIT (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Assessee pe Section 271AAB penalty laga di gayi thi. Income Tax ne notice mein nahi bataya kaunsi sub-section apply ki gayi (a ya b).
cases.issue: Kya specified clause na batane se penalty valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty radd kar di. Notice vague tha kyunki applicable clause specify nahi thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar penalty ka notice clear nahi hai, ya kaunsi clause lag rahi hai wo nahin diya hai, to notice ko challenge kar sakte ho. Har notice mein right clause mention hona zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Bannari Amman Educational Trust Vs ACIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Educational trust ke khilaaf cash rebate ki addition third-party diaries aur loose sheets par ki gayi thi. Department ne independent evidence nahi diya.
cases.issue: Kya bina independent corroboration ke third-party loose sheets par addition ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Sirf third-party documents se, bina concrete proof ke, trust ki income mein addition nahi ki ja sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke khilaaf sirf kisi aur ki loose sheets se addition ho, bina aapke business ka link dikhaye, to aapko wo addition challenge karna chahiye.

cases.case_name: East Delhi Leasing Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Company pe Section 147 se reassessment shuru hua tha, bas suspicion tha ki paisa ghumaya gaya hai. STR info thi magar koi direct evidence nahi tha ki income chhupi hai.
cases.issue: Kya sirf shak aur STR info par Section 147 ka case khola ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment khatam kar di. Sirf suspicion ya STR info se direct link nahi banta, toh reason to believe nahi hua.
cases.takeaway: Aapke khilaaf Section 147 reopening sirf shak aur vague info par ho to aapko turant reason to believe document maang lena chahiye. Department ko proper connection dikhana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Comtrade Commodities Services Limited Vs PCIT (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Company ka claim tha ki AO ne ESOP deduction ka theek se verification kiya tha. PCIT ne bina koi naya error dhundhe Section 263 open kiya sirf further verification ke liye.
cases.issue: Kya bina nayi galti dhundhe sirf further verification ke liye Section 263 lag sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 263 ka order radd kar diya. AO ne pehle hi deduction check ki thi, aur sirf further check ke liye revision nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein AO ne kisi deduction ko detail mein check kiya hai, toh PCIT sirf repeat verification ke liye Section 263 nahin chala sakta.

cases.case_name: Param Dairy Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Param Dairy ka case tha. Department ne Rs. 79.56 lakh ki penalty lagayi thi under Section 271AAB, par ACIT ne 3 show cause notice bheje jisme exact charge clear nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina clear charge bataye penalty lag sakti hai Section 271AAB mein?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki penalty notice mein specific limb/charge mention nahi hai, isliye penalty ko cancel kar diya. Taxpayer ko fayda mila.
cases.takeaway: Penalty notice mein sahi section aur complaint detail likhna zaroori hai. Notice vague ho to challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Sh. Jagjeet Singh Vs DCIT ACIT (ITAT Amritsar)
cases.facts: Sh. Jagjeet Singh ka case tha. Department ne search kiya tha, reassessment Section 147 ke under kiya, fir revision Section 263 lagaya.
cases.issue: Kya search ke baad galat section use kar reassessment kar sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, jab search se related material mile to reassessment Section 153C me hona chahiye, na ki Section 147 me. Galat section laga, to baad ki sari action radd ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar search hua hai, to hamesha check karo ki department sahi section use kar raha hai ya nahi. Galat section pe pura case challenge ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Kalpana Misra Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Kalpana Misra ke case mein Rs. 35.70 lakh Fixed Deposit department ne unexplained batayi. Assessee ne proof diya ki paisa husband se aaya hai.
cases.issue: Kya FD mein paisa ka source husband se ho to addition ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di, bola husband ka source clear hai. Interest clubbing ka direction diya ki jo FD ka interest hai wo husband ki income me jodega.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke FD ya investment ka paisa family member se aaya hai to proper bank proof rakho. Interest ka clubbing kis ke naam lagega ye bhi samjh lo.

cases.case_name: Bestone Industries Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Bestone Industries par Rs. 1.47 crore ki addition thi, salary, director interest aur creditors ke naam pe. AO ne bina proof ke adjust kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina evidence ke aise hi ad hoc addition kar sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne sari additions hata di. Bola, koi factual ya documentary base nahi hai to aise additions valid nahi hain.
cases.takeaway: Agar kisi addition ka ground clear nahi hai ya koi document nahi hai, aap usko appeal mein challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Veena Chadha Vs Assessing Officer (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Veena Chadha ne capital gains par Section 54 claim kiya tha. Flat builder ne time pe deliver nahi kiya, par investment time pe ho gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 54 relief mil sakti hai jab ghar milne mein delay hua hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola, relief deny nahi kar sakte sirf isliye ki builder ne flat late diya, agar investment time pe hai. Case wapas verification ke liye bheja.
cases.takeaway: Section 54 claim mein sabse important timely investment ka proof hai. Builder delay ho tab bhi receipt aur payment ka record important hai.

cases.case_name: Azure Power Uranus Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Azure Power par Section 263 revision action isliye hua kyunki officer ne Section 270A penalty start nahi ki thi. Section 270A misreporting penalty hai.
cases.issue: Kya Sirf penalty nahi lagane se assessment order galat ho jata hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 263 ko quash kar diya. Bola, penalty start na karne se assessment order galat ya prejudicial nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar penalty proceed nahi hoti to usi reason se pura assessment revise ya cancel nahi ho sakta. PCIT ka order challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: JCIT Vs Bharat Construction (ITAT Dehradun)
cases.facts: Ek firm ka assessment kiya gaya tha jab wo firm company ban chuki thi. Department ne baad mein assessment kiya.
cases.issue: Kya assessment firm ke naam par ho sakta hai jab wo company ban chuki ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha, jab firm company ban gayi to uske baad assessment nahi ho sakta. Revenue ki appeal bekaar ho gayi, isliye quash kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar conversion ho jaye (firm se company), to purani entity pe fir se assessment nahi ho sakta. Registrar mein change show karo, aur timely department ko batao.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs L.N. Malviya Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Company ne GST par late payment interest diya tha, aur TDS par bhi interest diya par delay hua. Department ne travel expenses bhi extra add kiye.
cases.issue: GST interest, delayed TDS interest aur travel kharch ka kya treatment hoga?
cases.held: GST ka interest allow kiya because wo compensation hai. Delayed TDS interest allow nahi hua. Travel expenses ka ad hoc addition court ne hata diya.
cases.takeaway: GST ka interest genuine payment hai, allow ho sakta hai. TDS late interest ka dhyan rakho, proper timing pe pay karo. Ad hoc travel expenses ke proof sambhal ke rakho.

cases.case_name: Savex Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Vs PCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Company ne CSR ke under kuch donations diye the. Department ne Section 263 se revision pass kiya aur Section 37(1) se disallow kiya.
cases.issue: Kya CSR donations par bhi Section 80G ka deduction milega jab Section 37(1) se disallow ho gaya ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha, agar donation eligible hai to Section 80G se deduction milegi. Section 263 ka revision quash kar diya.
cases.takeaway: CSR donations dete ho to unko Section 80G ke under declare karo, sahi receipts lo. Sirf Section 37(1) ka disallowance important nahi - 80G claim ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Principal Commissioner of Customs Vs Bombino Express Pvt. Ltd. (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Courier company ka licence suspend kar diya gaya tha, unpe outsourcing aur KYC violation ka ilzaam laga tha.
cases.issue: Kya licence wapas mil sakta hai jab outsourcing breach proof nahi hua?
cases.held: Court ne kaha ki koi proof nahi ki company ne violation kiya. Licence wapas karne ka order sahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar department clear proof nahi de paaye, to aapka licence suspend nahi ho sakta. Pure KYC records ready rakho lekin department se solid proof maango.

cases.case_name: Dineshbhai Dayabhai Hadiya Akshar Vs ITO (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: CIT(A) ne 2009-10 ke appeal mein 2008-09 reopen karne bula. Rs. 55.90 lakh addition Section 69 (unexplained investment) se ki gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya CIT(A) kisi dusre assessment year ko reopen karne ka order de sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha CIT(A) dusre saal ka case reopen nahi karwa sakta. Rs 55.90 lakh ki addition bhi hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar CIT(A) dusre year ke liye reopening bole to usko challenge karo. Section 69 addition ko prove karne ke liye actual investment evidence chahiye.

cases.case_name: Abhishubham Bahadur Saxena Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Assessee US shift ho gaya tha aur voluntary tax payment bhi kiya. Fir bhi ₹8.29 lakh penalty Section 270A (under-reporting) se lagayi gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya genuine non-filing ke reason par Section 270A penalty delete ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki explanation genuine hai isliye penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapne sach mein filing miss ki hai par valid reason hai (jaise relocation) aur voluntary pay kiya hai, to aap penalty delete karwa sakte ho. Proof rakho apni situation ka.

cases.case_name: Lodestone Software Services Private Limited Vs Union of India & Ors. (Gujarat High Court)
cases.section: Section 43B (expenses allowed only when actually paid)
cases.facts: Yahan ek software company ka case tha. Department ne fir se assessment khol diya kyunki unko laga ki Rs. 17.54 crore TDS ka deduction galat liya gaya hai. Par company ne actually kabhi woh deduction liya bhi nahi tha; unhone bas tax audit report galat padh li thi.
cases.issue: Kya bina sahi wajah ke assessment dobara khol sakte hain jab purana sab kuch record pe hai?
cases.held: Court ne reopening ko radd kar diya. Bola bas tax audit report galat samajh lene se dobara assessment nahi ho sakta, kyunki yeh sirf ek alag opinion hai, koi naya evidence nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar department bas galat samajh kar assessment dobara khol raha ho, to usko challenge kar sakte ho. Apne records clear rakho ki deduction actually claim hua tha ya nahi.

cases.case_name: Ganesh Valmik Bawane Vs Joint Director (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Ek aadmi ko GST ka show cause notice mila jisme 3 saal ki alag-alag financial years cover ho rahi thi. Department ne ek hi notice mein sab kuch daal diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya 3 alag saal ke liye ek hi notice valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne bol diya ki aise composite notice ko quash karte hain. Lekin department ko allowed hai ki vo naye hisaab se dobara notice bheje, par sahi process follow kare.
cases.takeaway: Agar kabhi GST ka notice ek se zyada saalon ka ek sath mile, to uski legal validity check karni chahiye. Department ko har financial year ke liye alag procedure follow karna padta hai.

cases.case_name: Hariharan Krishnan Vs ITO (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Case ek individual ka tha jinhone foreign country mein tax diya tha. Indian tax return mein Form 67 late file hua aur foreign tax credit galat column mein daal diya tha. Department ne credit mana nahi.
cases.issue: Kya sirf Form 67 late file karne se foreign tax credit reject ho sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola ki credit nahi roka ja sakta jab tak actual foreign tax pay hua ho, chahe form late file hua ho. Department ko verify karna hai ki claim genuine hai ya nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar galti se Form 67 late ho gaya ya column galat ho gaya, to bhi foreign tax credit ke liye try karo. Important hai ki tax actual pay hua ho aur sahi evidence ho.

cases.case_name: Sanjeev Sivasankaran Menon Vs DCI (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Ek assessor ne US mein tax time pe pay kiya tha par India mein Form 67 late file kiya. Department ne is wajah se foreign tax credit mana kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya late Form 67 file karne par credit reject ho sakta hai jab ki tax actual time pe pay hua ho?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola ki jab tak foreign tax actual pay hua ho aur wo income Indian return mein dikhai gayi ho, late Form 67 par credit mana nahi kiya ja sakta. Par department ko verification ka right hai.
cases.takeaway: Foreign tax timely pay ho gaya ho to late Form 67 pe bhi apna credit claim zarur karo, subject to verification. Payment aur income ka record ready rakho.

cases.case_name: Kishan Kumar Agarwal Vs ACIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Yahan search ke baad assessee ko Rs.12.76 lakh ki penalty notice mili thi. Lekin notice mein nahi likha tha ki kaunsa sub-section ya limb apply ho raha hai.
cases.issue: Kya bina clear category ya limb bataye penalty notice valid hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne penalty notice ko quash kar diya kyunki department ne notice mein specify nahi kiya ki kaunsa limb lag raha hai. Agar notice vague ho to penalty nahi lag sakti.
cases.takeaway: Department agar penalty notice de to hamesha dekh lo ki kaunsa section/sub-section ya limb specify hai ya nahi. Agar vague hai to usko challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Vishranthi Trust Vs ITO (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Ek trust ko Rs.48.94 lakh anonymous donation mila. Assessing officer ne yeh amount income maan liya kyunki donors ka detail nahin diya gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina donor ke naam aur address verify kiye anonymous donation ko income maana ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne case wapas assessing officer ko bhej diya. Bola ki pehle donors ke naam aur address verify karo, tab decide karo donation genuine hai ya nahi.
cases.takeaway: Trust ya NGO donation le to donor ke naam aur address ki list ready rakho. Verification ke bina addition ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Shri Borkatte Ganapathi Hegde (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Yah case ek property ke transfer ke baad ka hai. Assessee ne Section 54EC mein deduction claim kiya jab unhone property bechi aur uska paisa do alag financial years mein investment kiya, lekin 6 mahine ke andar.
cases.issue: Kya Section 54EC deduction milegi jab investment do alag financial years mein ki ho, lekin 6 mahine ke andar?
cases.held: ITAT Bangalore ne decide kiya ki Section 54EC deduction allow hogi agar dono investments 6 mahine ki limit ke andar kiye gaye hain, chahe woh alag financial years mein ho.
cases.takeaway: Agar property bik jaye aur Section 54EC bonds kharidne ka iraada ho, toh 6 mahine ki limit dhyan mein rakho. Financial year se farak nahi padta, 6 mahine important hai.

cases.case_name: Mistry & Shah Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Yahan ek CA firm ne section 35 ke under donation deduction claim ki thi, par reopening ki wajah se deduction withdraw kar liya, aur withdrawal reopening reasons milne se pehle hua.
cases.issue: Kya penalty lag sakti hai jab deduction withdraw kar liya ho reopening ki wajah se pehle hi?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di kyunki deduction khud voluntarily withdraw kiya gaya tha opening ki reasons milne ke pehle. Matlab, koi galat niyat nahi thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar reopening hone wali ho aur aapko lag raha hai deduction doubtful hai toh reasons milne se pehle withdraw kar lo, penalty nahi lagegi.

cases.case_name: Hardik Dayanand Patil Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Yah case penalty order ka hai. Section 271(1)(c) ki penalty extended time limit ke baad pass ki gayi thi; jo 30.09.2021 ko khatam ho gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya penalty order valid hai jab woh limitation ke baad pass hua?
cases.held: ITAT Mumbai ne penalty order radd kar diya kyunki woh limitation period ke baad pass hua tha, jo section 275(1)(c) ke under fixed hai.
cases.takeaway: Penalty order hamesha limitation period ke andar pass hona chahiye. Agar delay ho, toh usko challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Samunder Saree Centre Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Yahan reassessment approve karne ke liye sanction PCIT ne diya, lekin section ke mutabik 3 saal ke baad PCCIT se approval chahiye tha.
cases.issue: Kya PCIT ka approval 3 saal baad valid hai reassessment ke liye?
cases.held: ITAT Delhi ne bola ki 3 saal baad reassessment approve karne ka haq sirf PCCIT ke paas hai, PCIT ka approval valid nahi hai. Isliye reassessment radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment cases mein approval dene wali authority dhyan se check karo. 3 saal baad PCCIT ka approval zaruri hai, PCIT se kaam nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: Sakshi Agarwal Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Yahan 40 assessments section 153C ke under kiye gaye the, lekin satisfaction note me ye nahi likha tha ki jo papers mile hain wo total income nikalne se judte hain.
cases.issue: Kya assessment valid hai jab satisfaction note proper nahi ho?
cases.held: ITAT Delhi ne bola ki proper satisfaction note nahi tha toh assessment valid nahi hai, isliye 40 assessments quash ho gaye.
cases.takeaway: Section 153C ke cases mein AO ka proper satisfaction note hona zaruri hai, nahi toh poora assessment khatam ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: State of Himachal Pradesh & Ors. Vs Raj Kumar & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Yahan vacancy rules ki baat hai. Pehle rule amendment se pehle jo vacancies thi, kya unpe purane rules lagenge ya nahi, ye dispute tha.
cases.issue: Kya purane rules har old vacancy pe automatically lagte hain?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne bola ki har case mein vacancies ke liye purane rules automatically nahi lagenge. Rangaiah principle overrule kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar department mein old vacancies hain toh har baar purane rules apply honge, yeh fix nahi hai. Naya rule dekho aur situation specific decide karo.

cases.case_name: Damodar Prasad Agarwal Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Demonetisation ke time par assessee ne cash sales dikha ke deposit kiya. Sales books aur VAT returns me record thi.
cases.issue: Kya demonetisation cash deposit section 69A ke under add kiya ja sakta hai jab sales aur VAT returns matching hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 69A ki addition hata di kyunki cash sales books aur VAT returns me properly shown thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar demonetisation period mein cash deposit hai toh books aur VAT return properly maintain karo. Sameeksha hoti hai toh yeh jaruri proof hai.

cases.case_name: C. Anandane Vs Directorate of Enforcement (Madras High Court)
cases.facts: Yah case ek aadmi ka tha jo corruption ke case mein free ho gaya tha. Department ne uspe PMLA (money laundering) ka bhi case kiya tha. Jab main corruption wala case khatam ho gaya toh Department ne PMLA ka case chalaye rakha.
cases.issue: Jab aadmi main (predicate) case mein free ho jaye, to PMLA ka case chal sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki jab main case khatam, toh money laundering ka bhi case radd ho jayega. Isliye department ka PMLA complaint bhi khatam kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap ke khilaaf money laundering bhi sirf ek dusre case ke basis par hai, aur woh main case khatam ho gaya, toh yeh bhi automatically khatam ho sakta hai. Khud hi PMLA case na larte raho; main case pe focus rakho.

cases.case_name: Infosys BPM Ltd. Vs Additional Commissioner of Central Tax (Telangana High Court)
cases.facts: Infosys BPM ki GST order milne ki baat thi, par order na toh serve kiya gaya aur na hi GST portal par upload hua. Company ko appeal file karni thi par order nahi mila.
cases.issue: Agar order serve na ho, toh appeal file karne ka mauka mil sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne company ko GSTAT mein appeal file karne ki permission di. Reason yeh tha ki order sahi tareeke se diya hi nahi gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko order milta hi nahi hai, toh aap late appeal ke liye court ja sakte hain. Hamesha proof sambhal kar rakhein ki aapko order mila ya nahi.

cases.case_name: PCIT Vs Nahar Enterprises (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Yeh builder ka case tha, jisme department ne project ke flower-bed aur service area ko built-up area mein jod diya tha. Section 80IB(10) housing project ke tax deduction ke liye hai. Deduction milne ya na milne ka yahi mudda tha.
cases.issue: Section 80IB(10) mein built-up area mein flower-bed aur service area include hoga ya nahi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Revenue ki appeal radd kar di aur decide kiya ki flower-bed aur service area built-up area mein count nahi honge. Deduction mil sakta hai.
cases.takeaway: Builders ko deduction chahiye toh floor plan mein flower-bed aur service area ko alag dikhayein. Unko built-up area mein mat include karein.

cases.case_name: Hind Maha Mineral LLP Vs State of Maharashtra (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: LLP ka GST order bina proper sunway decide ho gaya. Department ne Section 75(4) ka, jisme personal hearing ka right hai, uska violation kiya. Dusra, Section 74A(8)(ii) bhi breach hua.
cases.issue: Personal hearing dena mandatory hai ya department bina sune order pass kar sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne kaha bina hearing ka order galat hai aur GST order radd kar diya. Department par 50,000 rupaye ki cost bhi lagayi.
cases.takeaway: GST mein jab bhi notice aaye, hearing ka likhit demand karo. Agar bina sune order aaye toh turant High Court mein challenge karo.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs I Energizer Holdings Ltd. (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Foreign company ka case tha. Department ne Section 144C (jo foreign companies ke assessment pe draft order dene ka rule hai) follow nahi kiya. Assessee ne yahi point uthaya.
cases.issue: Section 144C ke bina draft assessment order diya ja sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne decide kiya ki Section 144C ka draft order bahut zaroori hai. Jab yeh nahi diya gaya toh assessment radd ho jayega.
cases.takeaway: Agar foreign company hai aur Section 144C ka draft order nahi mila, turant assessment ko challenge karo. Department galti karta hai toh case wapas ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Krishna Kant Thakur Vs Union of India (Patna High Court)
cases.facts: Yeh case government ke work contract ka tha. Department ne bina pura evidence dekhe service tax demand laga di thi. Baad mein kuch nayi papers aaye jo record pe nahi the.
cases.issue: Jab nayi evidence aaye toh kya purani demand valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne service tax demand wapas bhej di fresh review ke liye. Saare nayi papers dekhkar dobara faisla karne ka order diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein nayi document ya record hai, toh usko submit karo. Court wapas department ko nayi review ke liye bhej sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Khivraj Motors Vs ACIT (Karnataka High Court)
cases.facts: Khivraj Motors ka case tha. Department ne reassessment notice bheja, jabki same income pe partner ke against already action chal raha tha.
cases.issue: Kya ek hi income ke liye firm aur partner dono ke khilaf alag alag karwai ho sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne kaha, ye galat hai. Reassessment notice wapas le li. Ye bhi order diya ki phir se socha jaaye kyunki same income pe pehle se case chal raha hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke business aur partner, dono pe ek hi income ke liye notice aaye to turant challenge karo. Double assessment nahi ho sakta.

cases.case_name: Apoorva Harish Ruparel v. Assessment Unit (Karnataka High Court)
cases.facts: Apoorva Harish Ruparel ka case tha. Income Tax ne notices secondary email id aur purane address pe bhej diye. Iss wajah se assessee ko pata hi nahi chala.
cases.issue: Kya department notice galat email ya purane address pe bhej ke assessment kar sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne assessment, penalty aur bank attachment sab radd kar diye. Galat process follow hua tha.
cases.takeaway: Hamesha apna address aur email department ke records mein update rakho. Notice galat jagah gaya ho to uske against turant action lo.

cases.case_name: Sandeep Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Ye case Sandeep ka tha. Usko land acquisition ke kaaran extra compensation mila aur uspe Section 28 ke tahat interest diya gaya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 28 ke interest pe tax lagega ya woh exempt hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne decide kiya ki yeh interest, enhanced compensation ka part hai aur Section 10(37) ke under exempt hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko land acquisition mein Section 28 ka interest mile to usse exempt income declare karo. Return file karte waqt Section 10(37) ka claim jaroor karo.

cases.case_name: Anita Packaging Vs Assistant Commissioner (ST) (Telangana High Court)
cases.facts: Anita Packaging ka consultant time se appeal file nahi kar paaya tha. Department ne Section 73 ke tahat demand order pass kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya late appeal file karne par fir bhi sunwai ka mauka mil sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne company ko do hafte ka samay diya. Ab statutory pre-deposit ke sath appeal aur delay condonation application file kar sakte hain.
cases.takeaway: Agar appeal time se na ho paaye to jaldi se delay condonation ke sath appeal file karo. Court soft approach le sakta hai, par time mat waste karo.

cases.case_name: Puneet Batra Vs Union of India & Ors. (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Advocate Puneet Batra ke premises par CGST search hua. Search ke dauran, client ki confidential details bhi thi.
cases.issue: Kya advocate ke office ki search legal hai aur client privilege maintain kiya jaa sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne search ko sahi mana, par authority ko bola privilege data ya unrelated documents ko protect karna hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar office par search ho to immediately client privilege documents ki list de do. Officers ko batana hoga ki kaunse papers privileged hain.

cases.case_name: PSS Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Vs Assessment Unit (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: PSS Solutions Pvt. Ltd. ke case mein department ne kisi third party ke Excel-sheet entries ke basis par unexplained money ka addition kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya sirf third party data ki entries par addition ho sakti hai jab actual cash ya asset nahi mila ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha sirf Excel-sheet entry se Section 69A addition nahi ho sakta, jab tak real unexplained money nahi milti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke against sirf kisi dusre ki sheet ya paper se addition ho, to usko challenge karo. Bina physical evidence ke wo tik nahi sakta.

cases.case_name: Vineet Arya Vs DCIT (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Vineet Arya ka case tha. Unhone shares beche aur un par long term capital gains (LTCG) dikhaya. Department ne lagbhag 16 lakh ka bogus LTCG maan ke addition ki, aur reopening ki under Section 147.
cases.issue: Kya reopening sahi thi aur LTCG ki addition justified thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 147 ke tahat reopening ko valid maana. Lekin court ne kaha ki specific evidence nahi mila ki transaction bogus tha, isliye LTCG ki addition hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar shares ya LTCG par addition ho, to department ko transaction-specific evidence dikhana zaroori hai. General suspicion kaam nahi karega.

cases.case_name: Dhartivarsha Estate Holders Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Yah case ek real estate company ka tha. Land conversion hua aur uski stamp value zyada nikli, kyunki conversion ke paise khud buyer ne diye the. Department ne high stamp value ko pakad ke addition kar di under Section 56(2)(x).
cases.issue: Kya buyer ke paise se land conversion value ko addition maana jaa sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Bola ki jab conversion ka kharcha buyer ne uthaya hai to assessee par yeh value ka addition nahi banta.
cases.takeaway: Land sale mein agar buyer direct kharcha uthata hai (like conversion charges), to wo assessee ki taxable income nahi bani samjhi jayegi.

cases.case_name: Prakash Chandra Mukherjee Vs ITO (ITAT Ranchi)
cases.facts: Property sale pe dispute tha. Taxpayer ne sale agreement ek date pe kiya, registry baad mein hui. Department ne registry ki date ka stamp value pakda, aur section 50C mein addition kar di.
cases.issue: Kya Section 50C ka agreement-date wala proviso pichle saalon pe bhi lagu hota hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki Section 50C ka proviso retrospectively apply nahi hoga. Matlab, AY 2013-14 ke liye registry ki date hi maani jayegi, agreement date ka benefit nahi milega.
cases.takeaway: Agar registry aur agreement mein time gap ho to section 50C ka naya proviso purane saalon pe nahi chalega. Sirf naye cases pe hi ye benefit hai.

cases.case_name: Kalpana Devi Vs ITO (ITAT Ranchi)
cases.facts: 20 acre zameen par farming ka case tha. Pehle bhi department ne 8 lakh ka agricultural income maan liya tha. Ek aur bench ne per acre 1 lakh ka standard estimate diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya itni agricultural income reasonable hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne poori 8.91 lakh ki agricultural income maan li. Pichle estimate aur department ki prior acceptance ko dekha.
cases.takeaway: Agar pehle bhi department ne aapki agricultural income ko accept kiya hai, to waisa hi estimate agli baar bhi defend ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Miraj Digvijay Shah (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Search ke dauraan 1.57 crore ki ancestral jewellery aur 40 lakh cash milne par department ne addition kar diya. Assessee ne valuation reports, affidavits aur cash-book diye as evidence.
cases.issue: Kya jewellery aur cash ka addition valid hai jab sab document mil gaye hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne sare addition hata diye. Court ne diya evidence, affidavits aur cash book ko genuine maana.
cases.takeaway: Agar search mein jewellery cash pakdi jaye, to valuation, affidavit aur cash book jaise proof sambhal ke rakho - inki wajah se addition cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Amigo Finstock Private Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Company ne bank ke through loan repay kiya. Department ne Section 147 mein reopening ki aur cash exchange ka doubt dikhake bogus loan addition ki.
cases.issue: Kya bank channel repayment ke bawajood bogus loan addition ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reopening ko to thik maana lekin bank channel clear hone par addition hata di, bola evidence nahi mila cash exchange ka.
cases.takeaway: Agar loan genuine hai aur saara repayment bank ke through hai, to cash ki entry na ho to addition radd ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Manaksia Steels Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Kolkata)
cases.facts: Company ka TP adjustment tha ki depreciation ka treatment comparables aur assessee dono pe alag tha. Department ne ₹1.13 crore ka adjustment laga diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya depreciation alag-alag treat karne se TNMM margin sahi rehta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne depreciation ka consistent treatment na milne pe entire TP adjustment hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar transfer pricing mein depreciation sabhi par barabar nahi liya gaya to adjustment radd ho sakta hai. Audit sheet check kar lo ki same principle laga hai ya nahi.

cases.case_name: Akshaya Teja Shree Engineering Works Vs Deputy State Tax Officer (Telangana High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek engineering firm ka GST registration cancel ho gaya tha. Pichla revocation application reject ho chuka tha. Unhone court mein manual application dene ki permission maangi.
cases.issue: Kya fresh manual revocation application di ja sakti hai jab purana reject ho chuka hai?
cases.held: Court ne kaha ki company ko do hafte mein manual application phir se file karne ka mauka diya jaye. Pichle order ka asar na ho.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka GST registration cancel ho gaya aur application reject ho gaya ho, to high court se manual filing ka mauka mil sakta hai. Do hafte ke andar manual application file karo.

cases.case_name: Serajuddin And Co. Vs DCIT/ACIT (ITAT Cuttack)
cases.facts: Department ne assessee ke khilaf ₹3.50 crore add kiya, bas ek third-party Telegram chat par jo verify nahi ho paayi. Assessee ka us chat mein koi lena dena nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina verify third-party chat par addition kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Sirf third-party chat, bina proof ya assessee ke involvement ke, taxable income nahi ban sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par third-party digital chat ya document par addition ho to verify na hone ki ground jarur uthaiye. Department ko aapka link sabit karna padega.

cases.case_name: Shaikh Sujayat Shaikh Islam Vs ITO (ITAT Nagpur)
cases.facts: Yahan assessee par ₹5.05 lakh ka penalty lag gaya tha Section 271D ke tehat (ye section cash loan lene par penalty deta hai). Pehle koi assessment ya AO ka santosh nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya AO ki satisfaction bina Section 271D penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty radd kar di kyunki officer ne bina apne satisfaction ke direct penalty laga di thi. Proper procedure follow nahi hua tha.
cases.takeaway: Cash loan cases mein officer ko dikhana hota hai ki penalty lagane ki wajah unke samne sahi bani. Bina likhe santosh, penalty khatam ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Neelam Gupta Vs DCIT (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.facts: Yahan ek hospital ka case tha. Department ne receipts main kaafi additions kar di aur diary based entries, including ₹1.40 crore medical donation bhi jod diya.
cases.issue: Kya pura addition justified tha ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne sirf 5% receipts par addition allow ki, baaki diary aur donation based additions hata di. Court ne kaha sirf estimate ke basis par pura addition nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Hospital ya cash intensive business mein department sirf estimate par pura receipts add nahi kar sakta. Sahi calculation na ho to visheshta sirf limited addition tikti hai.

cases.case_name: Budnar Jayakar Shetty Vs DCIT (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Assessee par search ke baad kuch penalty lagayi thi. Baad mein ₹23.83 lakh ka addition to hata diya gaya, par baaki income par penalty lagi rahi.
cases.issue: Kya jab quantum addition hat gaya to penalty bhi automatically hatni chahiye?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ki ek addition hatna doosre par penalty ko nullify nahi karta. Sirf ek head ke khatam hone se baaki penalty nahin hat jati.
cases.takeaway: Agar search ke case mein sirf kuch additions hat gaye hain, to baaki heads par penalty reh sakti hai. Har item alag-alag dekhi jayegi.

cases.case_name: Pvcon Engineering Co. Vs CGST And Central Excise (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Yahan GST penalty ke case mein, Supreme Court ne GST Appellate Tribunal mein appeal pre-deposit ke bina sun li. Ye matter sirf penalty se related tha.
cases.issue: Kya penalty-only GST appeals mein pre-deposit zaruri hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne allow kiya ki penalty wale appeal pre-deposit ke bina bhi ho sakte hain, aur 1 October 2025 amendment ki applicability ka sawal bhi uthaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap sirf GST penalty ke mamle mein appeal kar rahe hain, to abhi ke liye pre-deposit na bhi ho, appeal proceed ho sakti hai. Lekin amendment ke effect par nazar rakhein.

cases.case_name: Ankit Kumar Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Ankit Kumar ne ek property kharidi thi. AO ne pooch liya ki paisa kahan se aaya, aur Section 69 (unexplained investment) laga diya. Baad mein AO ne khud check kiya toh paise ka source mil gaya.
cases.issue: Sec 69 addition tab justify hai jab source explain nahi ho.
cases.held: Court ne bola jab AO ko source mil gaya toh addition rakhne ka koi reason nahi hai. Isliye ₹7.77 lakh ka Section 69 addition hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap investment ka source verify karwa pao toh Section 69 ka case nahi banta. Documents ready rakho jo paise ke flow ko validate kar sake.

cases.case_name: Rakesh Kumar Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Rakesh Kumar ka business hai. AO ne ₹20 lakh cash deposit ko unexplained maan ke Section 69A laga diya. Assessee ne bataya ki yeh business ka regular cash flow hai.
cases.issue: Business cash deposit pe Section 69A lagana sahi hai ya nahi, jab cash flow dikha diya gaya hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki business ka cash flow hamesha declared profit tak simit nahi hota. Agar cash trail dikha di gayi to addition nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar bank deposit ka source business cash flow hai toh cash trail zarur dikhao, taaki Section 69A na lage.

cases.case_name: Neelam Gupta Vs DCIT (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.facts: Neelam Gupta hospital chala rahi thi. Rs 1.40 crore tak ka alleged medical admission donation aur diary ke basis pe income add ki gayi. ITAT ne sirf 5% receipts pe addition allow kiya aur baaki sab diary/RD waali unexplained income hata di.
cases.issue: Diary based ya estimate income additions bina solid evidence ke kitni valid hain?
cases.held: Court ne bola sirf 5% receipts pe limited addition banti hai. Bina verify ki diary ya estimate se full addition nahi ho sakta. Donation wagarah pe addition hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Large additions tab nahi tikti jab evidence sirf diary ya estimate ho - actual document proof ho toh hi badi addition tikti hai.

cases.case_name: Robin Bhamboo Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Robin Bhamboo ne salary expenses claim kiye the. AO ne pura ₹32.53 lakh blanket disallow kar diya. Court ne wapas AO ko bhej diya ki salary ka reasonable hissa allow kare.
cases.issue: Salary expenses ka pura expense disallow karna justified hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki bina proper checking ke pura salary reject nahi kar sakte. AO ko bola ki reasonable amount allow kare aur baaki ka reason de.
cases.takeaway: Salary ka kharcha claim karte waqt proper proof submit karo – list of employees, payslips, transfer records, etc.

cases.case_name: Shaikh Saidque Haji Vs ITO (ITAT Nagpur)
cases.facts: Shaikh Saidque Haji ko reassessment notice sirf 7 din se kam ka diya gaya tha. Law ke mutabik kam se kam 7 din milne chahiye jawab dene ko.
cases.issue: 148A(b) notice kam din ke notice pe reassessment valid hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki kanun mein minimum 7 din ka notice mandatory hai. Usse kam ka notice pe pura reassessment radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko 148A(b) notice kam din ka mile toh challenge kar sakte ho – 7 din mandatory hai.

cases.case_name: Shaikh Sujayat Shaikh Islam Vs ITO (ITAT Nagpur)
cases.facts: Shaikh Sujayat Shaikh Islam pe ₹5.05 lakh penalty laga di, par assessment ya AO ki proper satisfaction nahi dikhayi gayi thi. Direct penalty laga di gayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya penalty sirf AO ki satisfaction aur assessment ke bina lag sakti hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki bina assessment ya satisfaction record kiye penalty nahi lag sakti. ₹5.05 lakh ki penalty radd kar di.
cases.takeaway: Penalty lagne se pehle AO ko apni satisfaction aur assessment clear record karna zaruri hai – bina reason ke penalty tik nahi sakti.

cases.case_name: Manchukonda Yethiraja Subrahmanyam Vs ACIT (ITAT Visakhapatnam)
cases.facts: Assessee par penalty lagayi gayi thi under Section 271AAB kyunki department ne Section 274 ka notice diya tha, par notice mein sahi clause nahi bataya tha. Assessee ka case penalty notice ki wajah se tha.
cases.issue: Kya penalty notice sahi hai jab usme relevant clause specify nahi kiya?
cases.held: Tribunal ne kaha ki jab notice mein clear clause nahi likha, to penalty proceed nahi kar sakte. Iss wajah se penalty ko radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko penalty ka notice mile aur section ka clause sahi se specify nahi ho, to us notice ki copy sambhal ke rakho. Aap Tribunal mein uspe appeal kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: Rajmoti Industries Vs ACIT (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Rajmoti Industries ka business tha. Department ne Rs. 9.35 crore ka GP addition kar diya bina books ko reject kiye, jabki scrutiny limited purpose ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya gross profit addition valid hai jab books reject nahi ki aur scrutiny limited thi?
cases.held: Tribunal ne yeh addition hata diya. Bola ki bina books reject kiye aap addition nahi kar sakte. Aur Limited Scrutiny ko extend karne ka process follow nahi hua tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par GP addition ho aur books reject nahi hue ho, to aap tribunal mein ye point utha sakte ho. Scrutiny scope check karna zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Kishorbhai Nathabhai Makani Vs ITO (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Assessee ko land acquisition ke case mein interest mila. Department ne interest ko alag treat kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Land Acquisition Act ka Section 28 interest, compensation ka part hai aur Section 10(37) exemption milega?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola ki Section 28 ka interest bhi compensation ka part hai, isliye Section 10(37) ki exemption milegi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko land acquisition mein Section 28 ka interest mila hai, to usko bhi compensation ka part treat karo aur exemption claim karo.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Maa Shakambhari Infratech Private Limited (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Company ne share application money receive kiya tha, saari entries books mein thi. Investors ka identity aur creditworthiness dikhaya gaya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 69 apply ho sakta hai jab share application money books mein proper record ho aur investors genuine ho?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola jab identity, creditworthiness aur genuineness sab established ho, to Section 69 lag hi nahi sakta.
cases.takeaway: Share application money lene par hamesha investor ka PAN, confirmation letter, aur bank statement jama rakho. Tribunal sirf properly documented transaction ko hi accept karta hai.

cases.case_name: Adinarayana Raju Mandapati Vs ITO (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Assessee ne book mein agricultural income dikhaya tha, department ne limited scrutiny mein cash deposit ka source poocha. Double addition kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya limited scrutiny mein department agricultural income ko source ke roop mein pooch sakti hai aur kya same income ki double addition ho sakti hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola cash deposit ko justify karne ke liye agricultural income dekh sakte hain, lekin duplicate addition nahi chalegi. Duplicate amount hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar agricultural income pe addition ho to check karo ki same amount ka double addition to nahi ho gaya. Limited scrutiny ke scope ki copy sambhal ke rakho.

cases.case_name: Subhaschandra Patel Vs DCIT (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Assessee ne Fiberweb shares mein invest kiya tha. Department ne penny stock transaction ko bogus maan ke addition kar diya, bina specific evidence ke.
cases.issue: Kya penny stock addition bina assessee-specific price manipulation proof ke kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne kaha ki jab tak assessee ke against specific price manipulation ka evidence nahi ho, tab tak Section 68 addition nahi chalega.
cases.takeaway: Penny stock ya share transactions mein department ka notice aaye to apni trade confirmations aur contract notes ready rakho. Yeh dikhana hai ki transaction genuine tha.

cases.case_name: Subramanian Manoharan Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Subramanian Manoharan ka case tha. Unpe ₹3 lakh ka penalty laga tha cash loan lene ki wajah se. Department ne yeh penalty 6 mahine ki limit ke baad pass ki.
cases.issue: Kya limitation ke baad Section 271D penalty valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty radd kar di. Judge ne kaha, law ke mutabiq 6 mahine ke andar order pass hona chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Agar Section 271D ki penalty hai, to dekho order time par pass hua tha ya nahi. Limitation rule ka faida utha sakte ho.

cases.case_name: ITO vs. Munirathinam Sivasankari (Chennai ITAT)
cases.facts: Munirathinam Sivasankari ke case mein Assessing Officer ne purana notice diya tha, jo baad mein law change hone se CIT(A) ne radd kar diya tha. Finance Act 2026 ki amendment ki wajah se basis hi badal gaya.
cases.issue: Kya retrospective amendment ke baad pehle ka order sahi hai ya nai?
cases.held: ITAT ne order wapas bhej diya fresh hearing ke liye. Bola, amendment ke baad fir se dekhna padega.
cases.takeaway: Agar reassessment notice cancel hua hai aur beech mein law badal gaya, to case dobara khul sakta hai. Amendment check karna zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Shiv Overseas Vs Union of India & Ors. (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Shiv Overseas ka IGST refund department ne rok liya tha. Company court gayi aur bola paisa atka hua hai.
cases.issue: Kya refund ka faisla jaldi hona chahiye?
cases.held: High Court ne kaha, ek hafte mein department ko final decision lena hoga. Agar delay hua to DGARM chief ki salary kaat sakte hain.
cases.takeaway: Agar IGST refund fasa hua hai, High Court se fast direction mil sakti hai. Strong follow-up ka fayda uthao, zyada delay par zimmedari officers upar ayegi.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Rajiv Sharma (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Rajiv Sharma ne pehle loan liya tha, baad mein bank ke through repay kar diya. Department ne loan ko unexplained paisa maan ke addition kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya loan repayment banking channel se ho to bhi unexplained money ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Bola, loan pehle liya gaya tha aur wapas bhi bank se kiya, toh explanation sahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar loan repayment bank se ho, toh sahi record dikhao. Pure banking paper honi chahiye loan ke har step par.

cases.case_name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Mandir Vs CIT (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: Ek mandir trust ki 80G renewal reject ho gayi thi kyunki department ne socha zyada paisa religious use ho raha hai. Trust bola, rule ke andar hi kharcha kiya hai.
cases.issue: Kya trust ka religious kharcha 5% se upar tha ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas bhej diya jaise hai verification ke liye. Saaf kaha, pehle check karo ki religious expense 5% se kam hai ya nahi.
cases.takeaway: Trust ko apne religious expenses alag-dikhane aur 5% limit proof ready rakhne chahiye. Renewal ke time yeh documents pakke se jama karo.

cases.case_name: Keshav Kumar Nachani Vs Encore Asset Reconstruction Company Pvt. Ltd. & Anr. (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Keshav Kumar Nachani ne apni appeal delay se file kari thi. Total 43 din ki late thi. Law mein appeal max 45 din tak hi extend ho sakti hai.
cases.issue: Kya NCLAT 45 din se zyada late appeal entertain kar sakti hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne delay condone karne se mana kar diya, bola 45 din ke baad power nahi hai.
cases.takeaway: IBC mein appeal file karne ki strict limit hai. 30 din ke andar karo, max 15 din ka extension hi possible hai. Der mat karo.

cases.case_name: Jyotsna Kunwar Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Jyotsna Kunwar ne startup mein ₹1.48 crore invest kiya aur Section 54GB exemption maangi. AO ne ₹50 lakh ki cap laga di thi, jabki assessee actual investment dikhata hai.
cases.issue: Section 54GB ka deduction ₹50 lakh par rukta hai ya pura investment mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne full exemption allow ki, AO aur CIT(A) ki cap wali baat evidence ke khilaaf maani.
cases.takeaway: Startup mein agar actual investment zyada hai, toh pura deduction Section 54GB mein milega. ₹50 lakh ki limit ka law mein base nahi hai.

cases.case_name: Subramanian Manoharan Vs ITO (ITAT Chennai)
cases.section: Section 271D (Penalty for taking or accepting certain loans and deposits in cash)
cases.facts: Assessee par ₹3 lakh penalty lagi thi Section 271D ke tahat. Department ne penalty order 6 mahine ke limit ke baad pass kiya.
cases.issue: Kya late penalty order valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki Section 275(1)(c) ke andar 6 mahine ki limit hoti hai. Uske baad order galat hai. Court ne penalty ko radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko penalty notice ya order delay se mila hai, to Section 275(1)(c) ki limitation check karo. Late order ko challenge kar sakte ho.

cases.case_name: ITO vs. Munirathinam Sivasankari (Chennai ITAT)
cases.facts: Assessing Officer ne purani notice bheji thi jo Finance Act 2026 ki amendment se invalid ho gayi. CIT(A) ne notice ko radd kar diya tha. Department ne appeal ki.
cases.issue: Kya amendment ke baad appeal fir se sunni chahiye?
cases.held: ITAT ne dekha ki law change ho chuka hai aur CIT(A) ka base hi khatam ho gaya hai. Isliye reassessment appeal wapas bhej di fresh decision ke liye.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment notice ke mamle mein amendment ya new law aane par purani order fir se khuli ja sakti hai. Har stage par latest law dekhna zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Rajiv Sharma (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee ne pehle loan liya tha aur bank se hi repay kiya. Department ne opening balance ko unexplained money maanke addition kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya loan repay banking channel se hua tab bhi Section 69A ka addition valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola reopening mein proper material nahi tha. Jab loan pehle se tha aur repayment banking se hai, to unexplained nahi maan sakte. Addition hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka loan purana hai aur bank se repay kiya hai, to uska detail har assessment mein ready rakho. Aise case mein Section 69A addition tik nahi paayega.

cases.case_name: Jyotsna Kunwar Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Assessee ne ₹1.48 crore ka startup investment kiya. AO sirf ₹50 lakh tak deduction dena chahta tha. CIT(A) ne bhi limit lagayi thi.
cases.issue: Section 54GB mein deduction ₹50 lakh tak hi milegi ya poori investment par?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki AO aur CIT(A) ki baat record ke hisab se theek nahi. Poore ₹1.48 crore par deduction dene ko bola.
cases.takeaway: Startup mein investment par deduction lene ka plan hai to record clear rakho. Law mein limit nahi hai to full benefit mil sakta hai, AO ki arbitrary cap chalti nahi.

cases.case_name: St. Ignatius Church Vs CIT (Exemptions) (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Trust ki 12AB renewal application thi. Department ne reject kiya kyunki formal trust deed nahi diya tha. Baaki documents diye the.
cases.issue: Kya trust deed mandatory hai 12AB renewal ke liye?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola agar trust ki existence dikhane wale documents hain to formal trust deed ki zarurat nahi. Appeal allow ki.
cases.takeaway: 12AB renewal ke liye agar trust deed nahi to registration ya old documents ka proof ready rakho. Sirf trust deed ki wajah se application reject nahi ho sakti.

cases.case_name: Shiv Overseas Vs Union of India & Ors. (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Exporter ka IGST refund department ne rok diya tha. Exporter ne refund ke liye court me approach kiya.
cases.issue: Kya department ko jaldi se jaldi refund decide karna padega?
cases.held: Delhi High Court ne order diya ki 1 hafte ke andar refund ka decision lo. DGARM ka chief respond nahi karta to salary rokne ki warning bhi di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka export refund rok gaya hai to High Court jaa kar jaldi decision mang sakte ho. Delay par officer ki salary bhi ruk sakti hai.

cases.case_name: St. Ignatius Church Vs CIT (Exemptions) (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Ek church ki trust ne apni 12AB exemption renewal ke liye apply kiya. Department ne trust deed mangi lekin trust doosre documents se apni charitable activities dikhata tha.
cases.issue: Kya trust deed dikhana mandatory hai 12AB renewal ke liye?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki agar aapke paas dusre documents hain jo trust ki charitable nature ko prove karte hain, to sirf trust deed na hone par exemption mana nahi kiya ja sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap trust chala rahe hain aur aapke paas trust deed nahi hai, to renewal ke liye apne charitable activities ke aur documents rakh lo, kaam ho jayega.

cases.case_name: Green Valley Homes Developers Pvt Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Developer company par ₹5.99 crore ka loan bogus batakar Section 68 mein addition kar diya gaya. Revenue sirf investigation material par tike bina khud check kiye.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 mein addition justified hai bina proper verification ke?
cases.held: Court ne bola bina independent checking ke sirf investigation report par addition nahi ho sakta. Loan addition aur uska interest dono hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Section 68 mein addition tabhi hoga jab department khud verify kare. Sirf kisi aur ki report se kaam nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: DCIT-17(1) Vs Parth Constructions (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Builder par unsecured loan ko bogus batakar ₹1.62 crore Section 68 mein jod diya gaya. Assessee ne lender ki identity, creditworthiness, aur transaction ki genuineness ke documents dikhaye.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 ka addition sahi hai jab sab proof mil jayein?
cases.held: Court ne bola jab assessee ne lender ki saari details aur proof dikha diye to addition nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar loan liya hai to lender ke PAN, bank statement aur transaction ka proof bana ke rakho. Inquiry aaye to wohi dikhana hai.

cases.case_name: Salgaocar Mining Industries Private Limited Vs JCIT (ITAT Panaji)
cases.facts: Mining company ke upar liability ko Section 41(1) ke tahat taxable manna gaya, kyunki department ko laga liability khatam ho gayi hai.
cases.issue: Kya Section 41(1) ka addition tab ho sakta hai jab liability abhi bhi outstanding hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola jab tak liability actually khatam nahi hoti, Section 41(1) mein addition sahi nahi. Yahan koi cessation nahi tha to addition hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Aapki old liability agar books mein abhi bhi dikh rahi hai aur settle nahi hui, to us par Section 41(1) ka tax nahi lagta.

cases.case_name: NTT India Private Limited Vs Assessment Unit/NFAC/DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Company par ₹93.23 crore ka management fee transfer pricing adjustment laga diya gaya. Assessee ne entity-level margin compare karne ki baat uthayi.
cases.issue: Kya management fee adjust karte samay entity-level comparison thik hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki TNMM (entity level margins) sahi hai, management fee ka addition hata diya. 80G aur TDS wale issues AO ko wapas bhej diye.
cases.takeaway: Transfer pricing mein agar pure business level ka margin comparable hai to alag se management fee ka adjustment nahi hona chahiye.

cases.case_name: Kilaru Venkata Satish Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Assessee ke khilaf reassessment notice 3 saal se zyada time baad issue hui. Approval Section 151(ii) ke according sahi authority ne nahi di.
cases.issue: Kya 3 saal baad approval galat authority se mile to reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki approval agar galat officer se mile to reassessment notice radd hoga, chahe time limit ke baad ho.
cases.takeaway: 3 saal baad reassessment ka approval sirf proper officer se hi liya ja sakta hai. Verification form pe dhyan dena zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Vijay Bihari Kandhari (Supreme Court of India)
cases.section: Section 153C - Search or requisition assessment for other persons
cases.facts: Vijay Bihari Kandhari ka case tha. Bombay High Court ne Section 153C ke time-barred notices (2014-15 se 2019-20 tak) ko radd kar diya tha. Supreme Court ne High Court ka order barkarar rakha, koi dakhal nahi diya.
cases.issue: Kya time-barred Section 153C ki proceedings jari rakhi ja sakti hain?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Bombay High Court ka decision barkarar rakha. Time limit ke bahar diye gaye Section 153C notices radd kar diye gaye.
cases.takeaway: Agar Section 153C ka notice time limit ke andar nahi diya gaya, to wo radd ho sakta hai. Notice milte hi date check karo.

cases.case_name: GTV Sez Phase 1 Private Limited Vs Assessment Unit Face Less (ITAT Delhi)
cases.section: Section 56(2)(viib) - Share premium addition for closely held companies
cases.facts: GTV SEZ Phase 1 Private Limited ka case tha. Department ne DCF valuation par based share premium ko taxable mano, aisa addition kiya. Company ne deduction for interest aur advertisement bhi maanga tha.
cases.issue: Kya DCF valuation par based share premium addition sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Bola occupancy certificate jaruri nahi. Interest aur advertisement deduction bhi allow kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar share premium ka addition DCF valuation ke basis par hua ho, to sahi valuation report dikhao. Occupancy certificate na ho to bhi deduction mil sakta hai, zaruri nahi hai.

cases.case_name: Rathi Cement House Vs Union of India & Ors. (Calcutta High Court)
cases.section: Sections 74 & 122 - GST demand and penalty provisions
cases.facts: Rathi Cement House ke khilaaf ek hi GST show cause notice diya gaya tha, jo alag-alag financial years cover karta tha. Department ne demand aur penalty lagayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya ek hi notice mein kai saal ka GST period cover kar sakte hain?
cases.held: Calcutta High Court ne order radd kar diya. Bola aisa ek notice jurisdiction ke bahar hai, alag-alag saal ke liye alag notice dena chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko ek hi GST notice mein kai saal cover kiye gaye hain, to is par challenge possible hai. Har saal ka alag notice hona chahiye.

cases.case_name: Naresh Chand Vs Mani Mahesh Ispat Pvt. Ltd. & Ors. (NCLAT New Delhi)
cases.facts: Naresh Chand ne Mani Mahesh Ispat Private Limited ke khilaaf insolvency ki application dali thi. Company ne bola tha settlement ho gaya par operational debt admit tha aur koi pehle se dispute nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya sirf settlement se operational debt khatam ho jata hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne CIRP start karne ka decision sahi maana. Bola settlement se bhi jab tak operational debt clear nahi hota, application radd nahi ho sakti.
cases.takeaway: Insolvency proceedings mein agar settlement ya agreement hai, to debt pura pay off hui ya nahi, yeh dekh lo. Paperwork clear rakho ki sab kuch settle ho gaya hai ya nahi.

cases.case_name: Smt. Amritpreet Kaur Gill Vs DCIT/ACIT (ITAT Amritsar)
cases.facts: Assessee ne apne husband ki document ki wajah se ₹3.97 crore ka addition challenge kiya. ITAT ne 12% profit rate lagaya, A-22 aur TDS ki additions hata di. Department ki appeal bhi kharij hui.
cases.issue: Kya husband ke document pe based addition sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di aur kuch hisse mein assessee ko relief diya. Department ki taraf se bhi appeal fail hui.
cases.takeaway: Agar department ne kisi third party document pe addition kiya hai, to uska direct link prove kar paana bahut jaruri hai. Galat linking par addition remove ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Viral Chandresh Virvadia Vs ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Assessee ne tenancy rights transfer kiye. Department ne tax laga diya. FMV (fair market value) 01.04.2001 ko kitna tha, is par dispute tha. ITAT ne FMV wapas AO ko decide karne bhej diya.
cases.issue: Kya tenancy rights transfer taxable hai aur FMV kaise tay hoga?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola tenancy rights transfer taxable hai. Lekin FMV kitna tha, ye AO ko decide karne wapas bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar tenancy rights transfer karte ho to FMV ka dhyan rakho. Proper valuation report ready kar ke submit karo, warna assessment ulta-pulta ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Mekala Sharath Reddy (HUF) Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.section: Section 54F - Capital gains exemption for investment in residential house
cases.facts: Mekala Sharath Reddy (HUF) ne ek sath 13 residential units kharidi after property sale. Department ne deduction ka objection kiya, plan approval aur bank statement par sawal uthaya.
cases.issue: Kya multiple flats par ek sath Section 54F ka benefit mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT Hyderabad ne deduction allow kiya. Plan approval ya bank statement par objection nahi maana.
cases.takeaway: Agar property bech kar ek sath kai flats kharidte ho to Section 54F ka exemption mil sakta hai. Plan approval ya bank statement ki details se exemption roka nahi ja sakta.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Anand Kumar Agarwal (ITAT Raipur)
